One line: **can the memory-access address stream alone — no activation values,
no logits leaving the device — steer a draft model enough to matter?**

This is v2. The original blueprint's Phase 1 (inject a random-codebook
HashedNet into a dense MLP, log "top-N weighted" hash indices) is dead on two
counts recorded in DECISIONS D-1: a dense hashed matmul's access set is
input-independent, and the weighting needs values the observer cannot see.
Everything below is rebuilt around telemetry that is input-dependent *by
architecture* and an evaluation protocol that cannot fool itself.

## The premise, stated honestly

A weight-serving memory device (or any tiered/fetch-on-demand weight store)
observes which weight groups the target model touches per token. That address
stream is a free byproduct of inference — no extra compute on the accelerator,
no floats on the wire. The question is whether a tiny sidecar on that stream
can predict enough about the target's near-future tokens to bias a draft
model's logits and raise speculative-decoding acceptance.

Mature framing: SD^2 (see docs/PRIOR_ART.md) steers drafters with the
verifier's *hidden states* and gains +35% accepted tokens. We are asking what
fraction of that survives when the feature vector is a hash sketch of the
access pattern instead of the hidden state. Our ceiling is their number; our
novelty is the observability constraint. If the answer is "most of it," the
hardware story writes itself; if "none," the project dies cheaply (see
docs/WHY_THIS_DIES.md).

Safety property that makes all of this low-risk to try: the verifier is
untouched, so steering can only change speed, never the output distribution —
proven exact to machine epsilon, including under arbitrary steering (F-0,
F-1).

Origin frame (recorded 2026-08-30 so the motivation survives the pivots):
this project began as "hide the SRAM<->VRAM transfer latency of a
hashnet-compressed tier behind steered speculative decoding." That goal was
never discounted — it was decomposed. Tokens-per-target-call IS the
transfer-latency budget: serial decoding pays the slow tier once per token,
speculation once per block, so every accepted token divides the slow path's
per-token cost (measured: 3.11 tokens per target call on the Llama pair —
READ AS the amortization budget; the transfer cost model itself is
unmeasured, K-5). "Acceptance" throughout this repo is that number read as a
speed/latency-tolerance currency — never model accuracy, which is provably
unchanged. What died on day one was only the hashnet-as-telemetry-source
(D-1, and see its 2026-08-30 scope note: compute-tier taps survive); the
schedule half of the SRAM intuition lives in OQ-11, and the "is the
latency budget big enough" question is K-5/K-6, deliberately last.

## Signal flow

```
                    ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                    │ target model (verifier)      │
   prefix ────────► │  forward over prefix+drafts  │──► p_1..p_γ, p_bonus ──► accept/reject
                    │                              │         (specdec.py, exact)
                    │  weight fetches ────┐        │
                    └─────────────────────┼────────┘
                                          ▼
                              address stream (slot / expert ids only)
                                          ▼
                              sidecar decoder (tiny, linear first)
                                          ▼
                              predicted concept bucket + confidence
                                          ▼
              ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │ draft model: q ──► gates ──► q' = bias(q, b, β)│
              │   gate 1: disagreement (q's top concept ≠ b) │
              │   gate 2: confidence   (conf ≥ τ)            │
              └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Causality: the sidecar sees telemetry from ≤ the last verified position and
holds its prediction for the block (D-2). The verifier never changes.

## What v0.1.0 already establishes (synthetic regime — carry the tags)

- The verifier floor is exact; steering is lossless (F-0, F-1).
- Most rejections are cross-bucket, more so for weaker drafts (F-2: 76–89%).
- Uniform boosting self-cancels; **disagreement gating** is the mechanism
  that works, and it moves the optimal β from 0.5 to 3–4 (F-3).
- Staleness decays the gain with offset; held buckets pay only when concept
  run length ≫ γ (F-4).
- Narrow sidebands with weak decoders are net harmful ungated and harmless
  with confidence gating (F-5).
- **This world cannot show telemetry beating free information** (F-6) — the
  existence question is real-model-only (OQ-1).

## Phases

Ordering principle: kill-shot diagnostics first; every phase has an exit and
a kill criterion; nothing depends on hardware that doesn't exist yet.

### Phase 0a — Real cross-bucket rejection audit  [first GPU task]
Goal: measure the addressable share of rejections on real models.
Tasks: `bucketize_vocab` (k=256/512/1024) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct;
`hf_specdec` with `--buckets`, γ=4, temperature 1.0, ≥200 prompts (mix of
instruct/story/summarize); `summarize_audit` per k.
Exit: cross-bucket fraction per k with CIs; per-offset breakdown.
Kill (K-1): if < ~25% of rejections are cross-bucket at every sane k, concept
steering has no room; stop.

### Phase 0b — Free-information steering baseline
Goal: establish the bar telemetry must beat, and validate the gate in real
bucket space.
Tasks: `hf_specdec --steer bucket --bucket-source free_lastp --steer-gate
disagree`, β sweep {1, 2, 3, 4}; glue-bucket exclusion per OQ-4; log
acceptance and tokens/target-call vs vanilla.
Exit: the free-baseline acceptance curve. This number is the denominator of
every later claim (D-5).
Kill: none — even a null here is information (it bounds mask-style steering).

Protocol (pre-registered 2026-08-29, before any steered real number exists;
amended same day on critic review, still before any steered number):
- Arms, all at k=512 buckets (committed sha), the committed glue json,
  data/prompts.jsonl x210, seed 0, gamma 4, max_new 256, temperature 1.0,
  NF4 target + bf16 draft, KV-cached, chat template pinned: one VANILLA
  re-run (`--steer none --glue ... --log-generated`; doubles as F-10's
  verification-by-rerun AND the mass-level OQ-4 source), then
  {free_lastp, free_lastp_sharp} x beta {1, 2, 3, 4} (both D-11 free
  variants; mech = posterior per D-10, gate = disagree), PLUS one
  always-gate control arm (sharp, beta 3, --steer-gate always): F-3/D-10's
  tax claim is defined by this control — without it a null across the gated
  arms cannot be decomposed into no-headroom vs gate-did-the-work vs
  glue-exclusion-failure.
- CONFIRMATORY arm, named now: sharp beta=3 (the a-priori D-8/D-10
  default). Its paired-delta CI is the single headline number; the other
  seven gated arms are exploratory curve-mapping (the exit deliverable is
  the whole curve, but any later single-arm claim cites the confirmatory
  arm, not the post-hoc best — multiplicity hygiene).
- Primary metric: paired per-prompt delta of POOLED acceptance
  (steered - vanilla), plug-in point estimate with a percentile bootstrap
  over prompts, seed 0, n_boot 20000 (tools/analyze_phase0b.py; same
  resampling recipe as verify_phase0a; cluster CIs elsewhere keep the
  sideband.stats default n_boot 2000, as in the committed summaries).
  Mean-of-rates frame reported alongside. Secondary: delta analytic drafted
  acceptance (the D-9 variance-reduced estimand, recorded per prompt) and
  delta tokens/target-call. Diagnostics: gate-open rate, n_steerable.
- Riders: (1) the vanilla re-run's pooled acceptance must fall inside
  audit_k512's cluster-bootstrap 95% CI (F-10 verification-by-rerun);
  (2) KV spot rider on the CONFIRMATORY arm: its FIRST 20 prompts (by
  index, the 0a precedent) vs a >= 20-prompt --no-kv-cache re-run at the
  same seed — the six bidirectional point-in-CI checks of verify_phase0a
  check A (both acceptance frames + residual mass); FAIL or MISSING
  quarantines all steered results (analyze_phase0b enforces this);
  (3) compared arms must agree on the cache path (metas match on
  no_kv_cache) — never confound path with policy.
- Interpretation guard: these are FREE-information numbers — the D-5
  denominator. A gain here is not a telemetry result; a null here does not
  kill anything (it bounds what bucket-bias steering can do with free
  information and calibrates K-2's later comparison).

OUTCOME (2026-08-30, F-12): the exit curve is a NULL — no arm positive
(best +0.0025, CI through zero), confirmatory arm -0.0098 [-0.0155,
-0.0039], harm dose-monotone in beta; both riders passed. Diagnosed cause:
gate open ~94% at k=512 (granularity, not glue identification — F-11/K-7
outcome; concept-bucket persistence 0.027 at k=512, so held predictions
are stale by construction). The D-5 denominator is 0 at this granularity.
Phase 4 is BLOCKED on OQ-12 (coarse gating space) — a predictor evaluated
through a net-harmful mechanism reads as noise and would fire K-3
spuriously. Phases 2/3 proceed: the harvest is granularity-agnostic and
K-2 compares information content, not steering deltas; OQ-12 informs
their label space.

### Phase 0c — OQ-12: coarse gating space (pre-registered 2026-08-30)
Provenance of the registration: the load-bearing anchors — the 0.25
viability bar, the C ~ 12-64 target range, beta=3, and the
pre-registration-first plan — were committed in 6045158 (OQ-12's opening
text and F-12's caveats) BEFORE any coarse artifact existed. This protocol
block was then drafted in the same working session in which the coarse
bucketizations and diagnostics were generated, and commits after them; the
committed anchor, not this block's timing, is the pre-registration
evidence. Where this block adds parameters beyond the anchors (verdict
cells, estimand naming, stage-2 criteria), they were fixed before any
STEERED coarse run existed — the only data seen at drafting time were the
viability diagnostics, which feed the registered rule mechanically.
Question: does gate+bias in a COARSE concept space (C ~ 12-64; the
synthetic evidence point is C=12 exactly) rescue free-information steering
from F-12's granularity failure to at-worst-neutral?
- Coarse spaces: fresh bucketize_vocab at k in {16, 32, 64} (same tool,
  PCA, seed as the fine spaces); glue per the K-7 rule VERBATIM (same
  committed frequency file, 80% cover, sensitivity sets recorded).
- Pre-GPU viability gate (tools/oq12_diagnostics.py, computed from the
  COMMITTED Phase 0a rejection records, which carry raw token ids): a
  coarse k is VIABLE iff its concept-cross fraction CI lower bound >= 0.25
  — K-1's bar applied to the coarse space. Non-viable k are not run.
  Persistence and glue-share numbers are reported diagnostics, not gates.
  Interpretation caveat to carry into any writeup: at k=16 the nominal
  headroom halves vs k=512, ~71% of rejections are glue-involved, one glue
  bucket holds ~59% of generated mass (the bias renormalization tax
  surface), and F-4's hold rule still fails (mean run ~1.14 << gamma) — a
  BROKEN outcome at coarse k is therefore overdetermined, and attributing
  it to any single cause requires more than these arms.
- GPU arms (stage 1): for each viable k, {free_lastp, free_lastp_sharp} at
  beta=3 ONLY (the D-8/D-10 default; F-12 showed the beta axis, this tests
  the granularity axis) — 210 prompts, seed 0, gamma 4, max_new 256, NF4,
  KV-cached, identical regime to Phase 0b. Paired against the EXISTING
  phase0b_vanilla_k512 arm: vanilla trajectories are bucketization- and
  glue-independent by construction (steer=none; buckets only decorate
  records), verified empirically on BOTH axes — bucketization-independence
  by the committed k=256/512/1024 audit identity (identical 11,287
  rejection tuples; verify_phase0a check C), glue-independence by F-11's
  bit-identical vanilla re-run — analyze_phase0b's gate-space exemption
  covers buckets_sha256 + glue_sha256 for these arms and records the
  exemption. No new KV rider: same code path and cache mode the 0b
  spot rider validated; metas must still match vanilla on no_kv_cache.
- CRITERION-BEARING ESTIMAND, named now: the EMPIRICAL paired pooled
  acceptance delta — analyze_phase0b's delta_vs_vanilla.acceptance_pooled,
  plugin point + ci95 (the Phase 0b primary). The analytic-drafted delta is
  the concordance check, never the criterion. Analysis invocation, fixed:
  `python tools/analyze_phase0b.py --arms phase0c_k{16,32,64}_{soft,sharp}_b3
  --gate-space-arms <same six stems> --skip-kv-rider
  --out results/real/phase0c_analysis.json` (the 0b KV rider already ran;
  --skip-kv-rider's quarantine wording applies to 0b arms, not these).
- Verdict cells, EXHAUSTIVE by construction (every arm falls in exactly
  one): WIN = delta CI95 lower > 0, sub-labeled gate-rescued (gate-open
  <= 0.5) or bias-despite-gate (> 0.5) — the two support different
  stories and are not interchangeable; RESCUED-TO-NEUTRAL = gate-open
  <= 0.5 AND delta CI95 upper >= 0 AND not WIN; BROKEN = everything else
  (definitively-negative CIs and open-gate straddles alike — an arm that
  neither wins nor rescues the gate is a failure of the coarse-gating
  hypothesis regardless of its CI's exact position). OQ-12 is answered
  NEGATIVE iff no stage-1 arm is RESCUED-TO-NEUTRAL or WIN; the strong
  form (every delta CI upper < 0) is reported when it holds. Phase 4
  stays blocked on a negative; salvage = the granularity diagnosis;
  Phase 2/3 proceed regardless. The existential claim over 6 arms is the
  registered object; per-arm CIs are uncorrected and any single-arm claim
  carries a multiplicity caveat.
- Stage 2 (only if some stage-1 arm is RESCUED-TO-NEUTRAL or WIN;
  registered now against forking paths): selector = highest
  acceptance_pooled plugin delta among rescued-or-better arms; at that
  (k, variant) run beta {1, 2, 4} and the always-gate control. A RESCUE
  enters FINDINGS as such only if stage 2 shows (i) the F-3 ordering
  (always-gate delta <= gated delta) and (ii) at least one other beta with
  delta CI upper >= 0 (the neutrality is a property of the mechanism, not
  one beta's luck). A stage-1 WIN additionally requires a seed-1
  replication of that single arm (same everything, --seed 1, fresh vanilla
  at seed 1) with delta CI lower > 0 before any positive steering claim
  enters FINDINGS — winner's-curse insurance.

OUTCOME (2026-08-30, F-13): OQ-12 ANSWERED NEGATIVE — all six stage-1 arms
BROKEN (stage 2 never triggered). The gate-granularity half of the F-12
diagnosis is CONFIRMED as a measured curve (gate-open 0.55/0.67/0.80 at
C=15/31/62 vs 0.94 at C=510); the mechanism still loses, with the residual
cause OVERDETERMINED per this protocol's own interpretation caveat — the
attribution rider below decides it. Free-information bucket-bias steering
is dead as built (beta=3 at coarse k) on this pair at k in {16,32,64,512};
Phase 4 remains blocked; Phases 2/3 unaffected (K-2's registered bar,
offsets >= 2, unchanged).

Attribution rider (registered 2026-08-30, before the oracle arm exists):
a mechanism-matched ORACLE-CEILING arm at k=16 decides F-13's residual-
cause question. `--bucket-source oracle_nextp`: per drafted position j,
the posterior is the concept posterior of the TARGET'S OWN distribution
p_j at that position, computed incrementally against the target KV cache
during drafting — per-position and fresh, NOT block-held; a D-2-NAMED
NON-CAUSAL CEILING (no deployable system has p_j before drafting position
j), existing only to bound the actuator. Soft mech (posterior), beta=3,
disagree gate, 210 prompts, seed 0, k=16 space + its committed glue,
NF4, KV-cached, paired vs phase0b_vanilla_k512 under the gate-space
exemption. Implementation gate BEFORE any run: at beta=0, oracle-mode
trajectories must reproduce the standard path exactly on the tiny-model
harness (per-step target feeding is the only mechanical difference), and
the KV A/B equivalence test must cover the oracle path. Decision, fixed
now: paired pooled acceptance delta CI95 lower > 0 => forecast quality IS
the residual failure (F-13's attribution upgraded to measured; a good-
enough forecaster could act through this mechanism at coarse k); CI95
upper < 0 => the ACTUATOR is dead for ANY predictor at this granularity
(F-13 amended accordingly; any "telemetry's opening through this
actuator" framing is withdrawn; Phase 4's unblock condition must name a
new mechanism); straddle => attribution stays open and is reported as
such. The oracle's gate-open rate and per-offset analytic deltas are
reported as diagnostics.

RIDER OUTCOME (2026-08-30, F-14): STRADDLE — +0.0014 [-0.0043, +0.0069]
(analytic +0.0033 [-0.0010, +0.0075]); attribution formally open, reported
as such. The measured substance: the oracle ceiling at the tested cell
(k=16, beta=3, soft, one seed) is bounded at <= +0.0069, and the
beta-invariant diagnostic is the truth-gate rate — 15.9% open (the gate
fires before any bias): at C=15 the draft already agrees with the
target's fresh concept profile ~84% of the time. The free predictor's
55.9% open rate is ~3.5x that (rates measured on each arm's own
trajectory; approximate); the free-vs-oracle paired gap is +0.0043 with
CI through zero [-0.0016, +0.0102] — consistent with forecast errors, NOT
decomposed. The granularity trap holds at every TESTED cell; the FINE-k
oracle (perfect forecast x the 0.61 headroom at k=512) is the open
remainder — the clean K-3 actuator ceiling; requires its own registration
before running.

### Phase 1 — Synthetic testbed  [DONE in this repo]
Everything in FINDINGS F-0..F-6; rerun `make experiments` to regenerate.

### Phase 2 — Real telemetry harvest
Goal: real input-dependent address streams, causally logged.
Tasks: `moe_telemetry` on OLMoE-1B-7B (64 experts × 8 active; fits one
consumer GPU) — primary; `shadow_telemetry` on the Llama pair (down_proj at
3–4 depths, n_slots 512, top_n 32) — dense stand-in. Labels: the target's own
sampled continuations (D-2), never corpus text.
Exit: ≥1M (telemetry, next-token-bucket) pairs per source with offset labels.
Kill: none (data collection).

Protocol (pre-registered 2026-08-30, before any harvest artifact exists):
- Sources, in run order. S1 SHADOW WEIGHT-SLOT TAPS on the NF4 target
  (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) — the D-1-scope-note compute-tier observer; zero
  downloads; primary on this box. S2 KV-PAGE stream (OQ-8/T-B): separate
  eager-attention pass, page_size 16, top 8 pages per layer, same layers
  and the same alignment; the over-heads aggregation, page-score
  definition, and prompt-region handling are TO BE PINNED BY DATED
  AMENDMENT here before S2 runs (they may not be chosen silently in
  code). S3 MOE ROUTING (the architecture-native address stream;
  allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct, 64 experts × top-8 per layer, all
  layers): blocked on a ~13GB download plus its OWN spaces — different
  tokenizer, so bucketize_vocab, harvest_freq, and the K-7 glue rule rerun
  verbatim on that vocab before its probes; protocol otherwise identical,
  EXCEPT that OLMoE's chat-template/date_string support and module naming
  must be verified on the box first, with any forced deviation recorded
  by dated amendment, not silently absorbed. K-2 verdicts are per source
  (D-1 scope note); S1 alone cannot settle the address-stream story —
  only S3 can.
- S1 tap spec: layers model.layers.{7,15,23,31}.mlp.down_proj (4 depths of
  32); importance_j = |a_j| · ||W[:,j]|| (the committed shadow_telemetry
  definition), column norms taken on DEQUANTIZED weights; HashSketch
  (n_slots 512, layer seed = base 0 + crc32(name) % 100000 — the committed
  convention); telemetry per anchor per layer = sorted UNIQUE slot ids of
  the top-32 units (−1-padded to 32). Ids only ever cross the wire
  (≤ 4×32×9 bits ≈ 144 B/token vs SD^2's 8 KB hidden vector).
- Generation regime: harvest_freq's regime parameters (target-only
  sampling, no draft; NF4; chat template with PINNED_DATE; temperature
  1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k 0; max_new 256; per-row EOS-set truncation) —
  the sampling LAW matches gen_freq but the RNG regime deliberately does
  not (per-row generators vs global manual_seed + generate), so
  trajectories differ from gen_freq's at the same seed and that is not a
  bug. Batched left-padded KV-cached decoding with explicit position ids;
  per-row sampling generators seeded
  np.random.SeedSequence(seed).spawn(n_prompts)[i] (D-6-style isolation —
  batching cannot couple rows).
- Block-start alignment, THE load-bearing convention (single
  implementation: sideband.harvest.label_index): anchor a holds
  (i) telemetry captured DURING the forward that produced p_a, (ii) free-
  information summaries of p_a itself: full raw bucket-mass vectors in
  ALL FOUR committed spaces k ∈ {16, 32, 64, 512} (f16; the coarse spaces
  are independent k-means runs, NOT coarsenings of k=512, so each needs
  its own exact log), full-vocab entropy, argmax, top-32 ids+probs.
  CONSTRAINT on Phase 3, fixed now: probe label spaces are restricted to
  spaces whose exact p_a mass vector is logged here, or explicit
  groupings of the k=512 buckets — otherwise probe (a) would be
  handicapped by under-logging and (c) > (a) could reflect information
  p_a HAD but the log discarded, not information beyond free.
  (iii) the OQ-6 reference feature: the final-norm hidden state h_a that
  produced p_a (f16) — the SD^2 comparison feature and OQ-6's
  DENOMINATOR; sufficient for offset-1 labels by construction, but at
  offsets ≥ 2 it is an EMPIRICAL reference, NOT an information bound on
  mid-layer taps (tap activations are upstream of h_a, not functions of
  it — a mid-layer can retain prefix information the final state
  discards); observability-violating, never a deployable source. Label
  at offset j = bucket(x_{a+j−1}); offset 1 is BY CONSTRUCTION the token
  sampled from p_a (free information's home turf); K-2 reads offsets ≥ 2.
  Labels derive from raw logged token ids at read time; the label bucket
  space is a Phase-3 registration within the constraint above.
- Volume + prompts: data/prompts.jsonl ×210 (committed sha), seeds 0..7 =
  8 sampled continuations per prompt. A pair = (anchor, offset) with the
  label in range. Exit needs ≥ 1M pairs summed over offsets 1..4; if EOS
  attrition leaves fewer, extend seeds in +4 increments under the same
  rule (a volume rule, not a design degree of freedom).
- Probe split, pinned before any probe exists: BY PROMPT — prompt_idx % 7
  ∈ {0..4} → train (150 prompts), = 5 → val (30), = 6 → test (30); never
  split positions within a prompt (leakage guard). All Phase-3 reads use
  this split.
- Storage + evidence: results/real/harvest_shadow/shadow_s{S}.npz
  (gitignored raw arrays) + committed shadow_s{S}.meta.json binding the
  npz by sha256 (harvest_freq precedent: CUDA sampling is not bitwise
  deterministic; the sha binds what was actually used) + a committed
  summary (tools/summarize_harvest.py: pair counts by offset and split,
  length/EOS stats, per-layer slot-occupancy diagnostics, mass sanity,
  cross-seed meta consistency). Findings cite the summary + metas.
  Archival duty: the npz files are bit-unreproducible single-disk data
  every Phase-3 result hangs off — a second on-disk copy outside the
  repo working tree is made after the harvest completes and its location
  recorded in the summary commit message; Phase-3 findings may not land
  while no second copy exists.
- Guards: buckets load via load_buckets(expect_model=target) with a
  full-coverage refusal; _assert_gpu_resident; preflight; redact_args.
- Interpretation guard: Phase 2 is data collection — NO kill, NO steering
  claim, and no "telemetry is informative" claim may cite the harvest
  alone; that comparison is Phase 3's registered protocol (probes
  (a)/(b)/(c), K-2 at offsets ≥ 2, per source).

### Phase 3 — The existence test (OQ-1)
Goal: does telemetry carry anything beyond the last verified p?
Tasks: three causal probes per offset j ∈ 1..γ predicting the target's
token bucket at offset j: (a) last-p features only, (b) telemetry only,
(c) both. Linear probes first (the sidecar must be tiny anyway); report
accuracy and calibration per offset.
Exit: the (c) − (a) margin per offset, with seeds.
Kill (K-2): if (c) ≤ (a) at every offset ≥ 2 across sources and probe
capacities, the address stream adds nothing beyond free information. The
project as a *hardware* story dies here; write it up as a negative result.

Protocol (pre-registered 2026-08-30, before any probe exists):
- Data: the committed S1 harvest (harvest_shadow_summary.json + 8
  sha-bound metas; 1,693,036 pairs) under the pinned prompt split.
  Disclosed diagnostics seen before this registration, feeding it
  mechanically (tools/audit_harvest.py → results/real/harvest_audit.json):
  cross-split 8-gram contamination 0.8% distinct / 1.4% occurrence (no
  replay concern), within-prompt cross-seed distinct-gram ratio 0.96,
  loopy rows 0.24%, and the label marginals quoted as baselines below.
  No probe of any kind ran before this block was committed.
- LABEL RULE: label spaces are CONCEPT spaces plus ONE merged extra
  class: concept ids 0..C−1 via glue_remap of a committed bucketization +
  its committed glue set; glue AND unbucketed tokens → class C.
  Predicting glue is part of the task (59%/41% of the label stream at
  k16/k512); dropping glue-labeled anchors would condition on the answer.
- LABEL SPACES (each satisfies Phase 2's logged-mass constraint):
  L1 concept_k16 (C=15, 16 classes) — PRIMARY, the OQ-12-informed
  granularity. L2 concept_k512 (C=510, 511 classes) — fine space,
  exploratory. L3 concept_groups_v1 — NEW, motivation recorded: label
  buckets whose makeup is a temporally coherent "conceptual idea" may
  give every predictor more to latch onto (user-proposed axis,
  2026-08-30; also a partial answer to OQ-2's bucketization-sensitivity
  note). Construction rule fixed BEFORE building: over the 510 k512
  concept buckets, estimate the bucket-bigram transition matrix on
  consecutive TRAIN-SPLIT tokens only (all 8 seeds; glue-labeled tokens
  dropped SKIP-AND-JOIN — flanking concept tokens become adjacent
  bigrams, pinned on critic review before building; bigrams are WITHIN
  one row only, never across rows or seeds); symmetrize the
  row-normalized matrix (S = P + Pᵀ); spectral clustering into 16
  groups (seed 0, n_init 10, precomputed affinity; sklearn version and
  assign_labels recorded in the artifact's provenance, and the FIRST
  successful run IS the artifact — no re-rolls); if degenerate (empty
  group), fall back to average-linkage agglomerative on distance =
  max(S) − S and record the fallback. Pre-build amendment (2026-08-30,
  dated BEFORE the artifact was built; critic round 4): the train chain
  sees only ~346 of 511 k512 classes (committed audit), so ~165 concept
  buckets have zero chain degree — a disconnected affinity graph makes
  the spectral embedding degenerate (an arbitrary rotation of a
  zero-eigenvalue eigenspace) WITHOUT necessarily producing the empty
  group that was the only registered fallback trigger. Rule: cluster
  only the nonzero-degree buckets; if their subgraph still has more
  than n_groups connected components, the agglomerative fallback fires;
  zero-degree buckets are assigned to the LARGEST group (ties to lower
  group id) with their count + assignment recorded — by construction
  they (almost) never occur as train labels, so the choice is inert for
  training and disclosed for the rare val/test occurrence. Labels:
  group 0..15 + glue class 16; L3 satisfies the logged-mass constraint
  as an explicit grouping of the k512 buckets (and (a) carries mass512
  in full per the amended feature rule above).
  Committed artifact: results/real/concept_groups_v1.json with full
  provenance + persistence diagnostics; if its train-split persistence
  fails to beat concept_k16's, that is reported, not hidden.
- PROBES, per (label space, offset 1..4, feature set, capacity, train
  seed ∈ {0,1,2}): features (a) FREE = ALL logged free summaries of p_a,
  identical at every label space — all four exact mass vectors
  (16+32+64+512 dims) + entropy + the top-32 sorted probs (ids excluded
  as non-ordinal, disclosed); 657 dims. Amended 2026-08-30 on critic
  review, before any probe ran: the earlier per-space 18-dim (a) was a
  HANDICAPPED free baseline — a positive margin could have reflected
  p_a detail that free information HAD but (a) discarded, the exact
  failure mode Phase 2's logging constraint names. D-5 demands the
  strongest available free baseline. (b) TELEMETRY = multi-hot slots
  (4×512 binary); (c) = (a) + (b); (h) HIDDEN reference = h_a (4096) —
  the OQ-6 denominator, never a deployable source. Capacities: LINEAR
  (multinomial logistic) and MLP-256 (one hidden ReLU layer) — K-2's
  "probe capacities" axis. Training, pinned: torch AdamW lr 3e-3,
  batch 4096, ≤ 30 epochs, identical budget for every feature set
  within a cell; model selection on VAL accuracy at epoch granularity;
  no test-driven selection of anything — test correctness is computed
  once per trained cell after selection and only the registered
  aggregates read it. Grid economy fixed now: L1 runs the full
  feature × capacity grid; L2 and L3 run LINEAR only over {a, b, c};
  (h) runs LINEAR at L1 only. Anything outside this grid is post-hoc
  and must say so.
- ESTIMAND (the K-2 readout): pooled test top-1 accuracy per cell.
  MARGIN(j) for a (space, offset, capacity) triple: per-prompt paired
  successes are SUMMED OVER THE THREE TRAIN SEEDS before the bootstrap
  (pinned 2026-08-30 on critic review, before any probe ran — one
  margin + one CI per triple; per-seed margins are point diagnostics,
  never CI-bearing, so there is no best-of-three-CIs pick), then
  prompt-cluster bootstrap over the 30 test prompts
  (sideband.stats.paired_cluster_delta_ci, n_boot 2000, seed 0).
  Disclosure: for LINEAR cells the train seed only shuffles AdamW batch
  order — near-identical fits — so the all-seeds condition below is
  weak protection there and is not sold as more.
  (DATED ERRATUM 2026-10-16: "the train seed only shuffles AdamW batch
  order" is false; src/sideband/probes.py seeds both the torch generator
  and the global RNG with the train seed before the weights are created,
  so the seed also sets the initial weights, and the per-seed margins of
  the committed payloads differ accordingly: over the 40 D and D_r rows
  that docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/seed_var_out.json rebuilds,
  the seed SE runs 0.33 to 3.26 times the bootstrap SE. The condition's
  weakness is as stated; the reason given for it is not.)
  Every table carries
  the named floors: majority-class rate (0.591 at L1, 0.413 at L2,
  test split, ~offset-invariant) and acc(a) itself (D-5: free
  information is the denominator, not chance).
- DECISION RULE (K-2 at source S1), fixed now: TELEMETRY EARNS
  EXISTENCE iff some registered (space, offset ≥ 2, capacity) triple
  has (i) seed-combined margin CI95 lower > 0, (ii) a positive per-seed
  point margin at all three train seeds, AND (iii) seed-combined point
  margin ≥ +0.005 — the same materiality floor gates both verdicts
  (amended on critic review: a significant-but-immaterial blip may not
  keep the project alive). NEGATIVE for S1 iff no such triple exists
  AND the best offset-≥2 seed-combined margin CI upper < +0.005.
  Anything else: OPEN, reported as such. MULTIPLICITY, owned: 12
  uncorrected offset-≥2 triples ⇒ family-wise false-EXISTENCE ≈ 26%
  under a global null at per-triple α=0.025 one-sided, before the
  materiality floor and cross-cell correlation reduce it (unquantified
  reduction). Therefore an EXISTENCE verdict is PROVISIONAL until a
  registered replication passes: harvest 4 fresh seeds (8..11, same
  Phase-2 protocol) and the firing triple's seed-combined margin CI
  lower must be > 0 on that fresh data before any positive K-2 finding
  lands (winner's-curse insurance, 0c precedent). K-2's project-level
  verdict is PER SOURCE (D-1 scope note): S1 answers the compute-tier
  tap story only; S2/S3 have their own runs of this same protocol.
- POWER caveat recorded before results: 30 test prompt clusters ⇒ wide
  CIs; a wide-CI OPEN reads "not detectable at this power", never
  "proven absent" — finding wording must respect this. (NEGATIVE
  requires a tight CI by construction and cannot be wide.)
- RIDERS, pass/fail before any probe number is citable:
  R1 HARVEST FIDELITY (GPU): 16 uniform-random (seed, prompt, anchor)
  triples, ≥ 4 with anchor ≥ 128; teacher-force prompt ⊕ tokens[:a]
  through the NF4 target (fresh full forward, no KV reuse) and compare
  the stored anchor: per-layer slot overlap ≥ 30/32, mass512 L∞ ≤ 3e-3,
  entropy |Δ| ≤ 5e-3, argmax equal wherever the recomputed top1−top2
  gap > 1e-2. FAIL quarantines the harvest pending diagnosis. The
  tolerances are a-priori estimates for NF4 cached-vs-full kernel
  variation; they may be recalibrated ONLY from non-audit anchors (a
  dated amendment), after which the rider reruns on FRESH triples.
  RECALIBRATION AMENDMENT (2026-08-30, the registered path, taken): the
  a-priori tolerances fired on 12/16 committed triples and the harvest
  was quarantined per the rule. Calibration on fresh seed-100 non-audit
  anchors under the exact harvest regime vs the exact rider regime
  (results/real/fidelity_calibration.json, 30 anchors + 30 deliberate
  off-by-one controls): ALIGNED kernel noise (bnb NF4 gemv-vs-gemm +
  cached-vs-full) spans overlap 27–31, mass512 L∞ ≤ 0.027, entropy Δ ≤
  0.038; the MISALIGNED control spans overlap 1–12, mass L∞ median
  0.99, entropy Δ median 0.37. DATED NOTE 2026-10-16: the calibration
  ran at batch 10 (N_PROMPTS = 10, encoded as one left-padded batch in
  tools/calibrate_fidelity.py), while the payload's regime string says
  "batch-16" and the harvest itself ran at batch 16; the kernel-path
  argument (gemm vs gemv) is unaffected, the reduction order differs.
  Recalibrated tolerances: overlap ≥
  20/32, mass L∞ ≤ 0.08, entropy |Δ| ≤ 0.10, argmax checked at gap >
  0.08. Support, stated honestly per criterion: overlap and mass sit
  ~3× above their calibrated aligned maxima and far below the
  misalignment signature; ENTROPY does not — the audit-triple data
  (v1 max 0.0734, v2 max 0.0773, both with clean overlap and mass)
  exceeds the calibrated aligned max ~2×, i.e. the 30-anchor/max_new-64
  calibration UNDERCOVERS the real entropy tail, and 0.10's support is
  the observed real-data band plus the misaligned median sitting 3.7×
  above it.
  DATED ERRATUM 2026-10-16: "v2 max 0.0773" is the rng-seed-1 rerun's own
  triples, the run this text then judged against the 0.10 bound
  (results/real/harvest_fidelity_rider.json: rng_seed 1, verdict PASS,
  criteria entropy_abs_max 0.1, largest entropy_abs_delta 0.0773; the failed
  v1 is harvest_fidelity_rider_v1_failed.json, rng_seed 0, largest 0.0734;
  both files arrived in one commit, e6b22c9, and this text never defined
  "v2"), so the entropy leg's pass is not independent of its threshold. The
  overlap and mass legs are independent of the rerun and stand, and the AND-
  structure limits what the entropy leg alone can license.
  Caveats carried: overlap is the sharp discriminator —
  adjacent positions can share near-identical p, so mass/entropy
  per-criterion separation is imperfect and the AND-structure (any
  criterion fails ⇒ triple fails) is load-bearing. CYCLE BOUND, fixed
  now: this was recalibration cycle ONE; a FAIL at these tolerances —
  on this harvest or any future one (the seeds-8..11 replication
  harvest included) — quarantines with NO further widening absent a
  NEW named mechanism plus critic review; rider rerun rng-seeds
  advance deterministically (previous + 1). Rerun on fresh triples
  (rng-seed 1): 16/16 PASS; the v1 FAILED output is preserved as
  harvest_fidelity_rider_v1_failed.json.
  R2 LABEL-SHUFFLE NULL (pipeline-leak detector; sharpened on critic
  review — a probe can legitimately learn per-prompt label COMPOSITION,
  which the shift preserves, so the null band is relative): with labels
  circularly shifted by +17 within each row, run the L1 LINEAR (a) and
  (c) probes at offsets 2, 3, 4 (seed 0); PASS iff shuffled-(c) ≤
  shuffled-(a) + 0.01 on test at every offset — both see composition;
  only a pipeline leak separates them. Above it = leak, halt.
  R3 SPLIT INTEGRITY: the split is recomputed from stored prompt_idx at
  probe-load time; any anchor claimed by two splits aborts.
- OQ-6 readout (reported, never a criterion): survival fraction at each
  offset ≥ 2 = margin(c−a) / margin(h−a), defined only where the h−a
  margin's CI lower > 0; if h itself adds nothing beyond free there,
  that is its own reportable observation. This is a ratio of top-1
  ACCURACY margins — a different layer from SD^2's +35% ACCEPTANCE
  gain; no "X% of SD^2" reading may be drawn from it.

S3 RUN OF THIS PROTOCOL — MoE ROUTER ADDRESS STREAM (registered
2026-08-31, before any S3 artifact of any kind exists — no bucketization,
no frequency harvest, no telemetry, no probe; amended same day on critic
review, still before any artifact: skip-list fix + post-load

- STAKES, per the D-1 scope note and Phase 2's S3 clause: S3 is the
  architecture-native ADDRESS stream — the experts a weight-serving
  device actually fetches — and the ORIGINAL hardware premise. K-2(S3)
  is the verdict that answers the address-stream story; F-15 (S1,
  compute-tier taps) does not transfer in either direction. A NEGATIVE
  here kills the address-stream hardware story specifically, with the
  compute-tier story untouched; an EXISTENCE here revives it.
- MODEL FACTS (verified from the local HF snapshot b89a7c4 this
  session, config.json + safetensors headers — not recalled): OlmoeForCausalLM
  allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct; 16 MoE layers; 64 experts, top-8
  per token (num_experts_per_tok), norm_topk_prob false; hidden 2048;
  vocab 50304; untied lm_head [50304, 2048] present; eos_token_id
  50279 (single, unlike Llama-3.1's set); max_position 4096; all three
  shards verified complete against their own headers (13.838 GB
  tensors). Tokenizer quirks, disclosed (critic round): BOS == EOS ==
  id 50279 — every chat-encoded prompt STARTS with the eos id
  (harmless here: EOS truncation inspects sampled tokens only, but a
  trap for any later token-level analysis); a real pad token exists
  (tokenizer <pad>; config pad_token_id 1), so no eos-as-pad fallback
  engages either way. The snapshot lacked model.safetensors.index.json
  (a metadata file); it WAS fetched from the hub 2026-08-31 before any
  run — the only network touch, carrying no experimental content.
- TAP SPEC: forward hooks on the 16 router gates
  model.layers.{0..15}.mlp.gate (nn.Linear 2048→64, verified in the
  installed modeling source). Telemetry per anchor per layer = the
  model's OWN selected top-8 expert ids, reproduced exactly as the
  block computes them (topk over float32 softmax of the SAME logits
  tensor the hook observes; softmax is monotone, so this equals topk
  on logits up to tie handling — we replicate the block's exact op
  anyway), stored as SORTED ascending int16 (set semantics: an
  address observer sees which experts are fetched, not rank). ADDRESSES
  ONLY: router softmax weights are NOT stored and may not be used as
  probe features — a fetch observer cannot see them. Uplink
  arithmetic: 16 layers × 8 ids × 6 bits = 768 bits = 96 B/token
  (S1's was ≈144 B/token). Storage reuses the npz key "slots" with
  shape (rows, T, L=16, top_n=8) so the ENTIRE committed Phase-3
  instrument (HarvestData, multi-hot, grid runner, riders, state-file
  machinery) runs verbatim with n_slots=64; the meta records the
  semantics ("slots = router top-8 expert ids per layer").
- LOAD REGIME (dated deviation from S1's uniform NF4, with rationale):
  NF4 double-quant bf16-compute for experts/attention (6.92B params do
  not fit a 12 GB card in bf16), with the 16 router gates EXCLUDED
  from quantization (BitsAndBytesConfig llm_int8_skip_modules=
  ["gate", "lm_head"] — transformers' skip matching honors leaf names,
  verified on-box after "mlp.gate" silently skipped nothing; leaf
  "gate" matches exactly the 16 routers, and lm_head is re-listed
  because an explicit list replaces the auto-skip; ~4 MB of router
  weights). Rationale: the router IS the
  observed instrument, real serving stacks keep routers at high
  precision while experts quantize, and a bf16 router removes router
  weight-quantization error from the address stream itself (upstream
  NF4 kernel noise in the hidden states remains — that is what the
  fidelity calibration measures). lm_head stays unquantized. CRITIC
  AMENDMENT (same day, blocker): the skip list is version-fragile and
  its failure mode is silent AND self-consistent (a rider recomputing
  under the same wrong load passes), so every load path VERIFIES the
  regime post-load by module INSPECTION (verify_load_regime: routers
  and lm_head must not be Params4bit; raises loudly) and the meta's
  load_regime_verified record comes from that inspection, never from
  the flag.

### Phase 4 — Steered speculative decoding, end to end
Goal: convert probe margins into acceptance.
Tasks: plug the trained sidecar into `hf_specdec` (extend the steer hook to
consume live telemetry); D-8 defaults (β≈3, disagreement + confidence gates,
τ tuned on dev prompts); report analytic-style acceptance, tokens/target-call,
and per-offset gains vs Phase-0b free baseline on held-out prompts.
Exit: acceptance delta over the free baseline with CIs.
Kill (K-3): if the delta over free_lastp is indistinguishable from zero, fold
back to Phase 3 diagnostics once; if it repeats, stop.

  prediction, per the primary comparison OQ-15's arc registration
  must pin — then OQ-16 is SKIPPED and the lane STOPS: both lanes
  read the same stream, and a stream carrying no
  acceptance-relevant information above free signals cannot fund
  either supervision (argument-level bridge, disclosed as such). A
  CONVERSION-mode null (information above free exists; the derived
  policy fails its bar) does NOT bound reconstruction — OQ-16
  runs.
- Each fold-back gets its own arc registration (bars, kill,
  populations, seeds) BEFORE it runs, per house rules; both are
  data-fed by the committed K-3 byproduct logs; the economics
  memo's bars apply unchanged (OQ-16's own pinned term).
- HARD STOP: the K-3 lane ends at the first WIN, or when both
  fold-backs have resolved, or when #1 resolves and the skip
  fires — whichever comes first. No third mechanism; no retries
  within a lane beyond its own registered void/robustness
  semantics. "A second null still stops" now reads over the
  widened sequence: after fold-back #2's null (or the skip), K-3
  STOPS.
- RATIONALE, disclosed: OQ-15 and OQ-16 are mechanistically
  distinct (classification -> scheduling vs dense regression ->
  injection); a null in one does not bound the other except
  through the shared information ceiling, which the skip condition
  owns. The widening is made BEFORE Attempt #1's verdict exists
  because after a null the identical amendment would be the "just
  one more" move the kill text exists to block — and the honest
  version of that line, per the critic: the clean window (before
  the breach was known) was already missed, so what carries this
  amendment is STRUCTURE, not timing — content-blindness,
  null-world-only binding, both candidates registered before any
  verdict arm ran, and the decidability pin below.
- DECIDABILITY PIN (critic blocker, pinned now): OQ-15's arc
  registration MUST pin an exhaustive terminal-outcome partition
  {WIN, information-ceiling null, conversion-mode null} — with the
  statistical criteria (what "fails to beat" means: CI treatment
  of straddles included) and the F-16 noise anchor's
  classification role (anchor-explained lift is which mode) —
  BEFORE OQ-15 runs. Any outcome the pinned partition cannot
  classify DEFAULTS to information-ceiling null, the conservative
  branch: skip OQ-16 and stop the lane. A sub-Lane-B OQ-15 win is
  classified by that partition too (the Lane-A-only guard
  applies to it as to Attempt #1).
- BRIDGE LOOPHOLE, named (critic advisory): the skip's ceiling
  argument bounds PREDICTION of current-policy acceptance, not
  INTERVENTION — telemetry could in principle carry
  steering-relevant direction while adding no acceptance-
  predictive information above free features, and OQ-16's own
  registered text resists exactly this style of imported bound.
  The skip stands anyway as a registered judgment call (it can
  only prevent an experiment, never create a false finding), and
  this clause exists so the bridge is never later cited as a
  theorem.

STAGE-E ENGINEERING CLARIFICATIONS (dated 2026-09-02, written BEFORE
any stage-E code, calibration artifact, or run exists; they close the
degrees of freedom the arc registration + freeze pins left open. Pins
are judgment calls unless derived; no pin reads anything beyond
committed evidence):
- (E1) LIVE PROBES: the scheduler's probes are the FOUR committed
  Phase-3 cells L1_concept_k16 | off{2,3} | {a,c} | linear at TRAIN
  SEED 0, exported via the registered binding gate (bit-exact
  reproduction of each committed state cell: test_acc, per-cluster
  counts, val_acc_best, best_epoch — the D2/D3-strengthened form;
  export refuses on any mismatch). Seed 0 is the standing convention
  (verdict seed, D2/D3 head-seed rule, rng lineages); DISCLOSED:
  per-seed D2/D3 numbers exist in committed evidence and were not
  consulted for this choice; the a-priori alternative (a 3-seed
  ensemble) is rejected because its calibration was never measured —
  the frozen signal's ECE evidence is per-seed. The off3 cells
  inherit the L1 SPACE from the D2/D3 selection (the freeze pins
  already read the off2/off3 pair).
- (E2) AGREEMENT/DISAGREEMENT SEMANTICS (the D-7 reading of the
  registration's "comparisons in concept space, glue excluded"): the
  probe's prediction = its full-label-space argmax (the class its
  frozen max-softmax belongs to — the D2/D3-measured object,
  unchanged); the draft token's class = the same merged label map. A
  comparison at an offset is DEFINED only when BOTH classes are
  concept classes (neither is the merged glue/unbucketed class).
  STOP's disagreement predicate = defined AND classes differ (AND
  the frozen confidence threshold, per the arc); EXTEND's agreement
  predicate = defined AND classes equal. An undefined comparison
  fires NEITHER — the block rides vanilla at that consult.
  DISCLOSED alternatives, rejected: treating glue as a comparable
  class would let gates fire on glue-glue matches, against D-7's
  committed exclusion; restricting the argmax to concept classes
  would change the confidence signal away from its frozen,
  calibration-measured form. Honest dynamic-range note: glue is the
  majority label at these anchors, so defined comparisons are a
  minority of consults — trigger rates are an empirical outcome of
  the val runs, not a promise.
- (E3) ARM-2 SIGNAL MAPPING (skeleton match): signal_j = q_j(x_j),
  the draft's probability of its own sampled token at drafted
  position j in {1, 2}. STOP at j fires iff signal_j <= its stop
  threshold (LOW draft confidence predicts rejection — the direction
  inversion vs the probe arms' "confident disagreement" is the
  mechanism-matched analog, disclosed); EXTEND fires iff
  min(signal_1, signal_2) >= the extend threshold. Identical 2-D
  quantile recipe: one stop level materialized PER-POSITION on that
  position's own val signal distribution, one extend level on the
  val distribution of the min. Arm 2 has no agreement predicate
  (scalar signal) — disclosed structural asymmetry, inherent to
  D-11 mechanism matching.
- (E4) EXTEND MECHANICS: one decision per block, evaluated after
  the base gamma=4 drafting completes (its inputs — block-anchor
  probe outputs and drafted positions 1-2 — exist by then),
  extending the SAME block's drafting to gamma=6 before the single
  verify forward. No consult exists at drafted positions 5-6 (no
  probes there — the registered bet). STOP at position j truncates
  the block's drafting at j tokens; positions >= 3 ride
  uninterrupted; STOP and EXTEND are mutually exclusive by
  construction.
- (E5) THRESHOLD MATERIALIZATION SOURCE: the quantile grids
  materialize on the block-start signal distributions logged by the
  VANILLA-ARM VAL RUN — the same registered run that freezes B_ref
  (30 val prompts of data/prompts.jsonl, idx % 7 == 5, in index
  order; seed 0; gamma=4; no scheduling): vanilla never consults a
  signal, so the distributions are policy-independent, and all
  signal families are READ-ONLY loggable there (arm 2's q_j(x_j) is
  computed by drafting anyway; probe outputs are pure functions of
  the anchor features). np.quantile, default linear interpolation,
  pinned. Val runs (the B_ref run and every tuning eval) use seed 0;
  the verdict population runs at seed 0; seed 1 stays reserved for
  the single void-rerun.
- (E6) GATE ARITHMETIC, pinned: tokens/call = emitted tokens per
  VERIFY call (n_blocks); drafted-per-emitted = drafted tokens /
  emitted tokens. The PREFILL forward (one per prompt, present in
  EVERY arm of the new instrument — it primes the target cache and
  produces the first block's anchor read at the prompt's last
  position, per the arc registration) is excluded from the call
  count UNIFORMLY; disclosed (a constant +1 per prompt per arm;
  including it would shift every arm identically and break
  comparability with the committed accepted-length closed form).
  The existing whole-block emission rule at the max_new boundary is
  unchanged and uniform across arms; disclosed. The pairwise
  tokens/call delta estimand = difference of ratio-of-totals with a
  JOINT prompt-cluster bootstrap (both arms' per-prompt (emitted,
  n_blocks) resampled at the same prompt indices; n_boot 2000, seed
  0, percentile CI — paired_cluster_delta_ci's conventions extended
  to per-arm trial counts; implemented in sideband.stats with numpy
  tests, never re-derived in a tool). Budget-guard comparisons use
  pooled-total drafted-per-emitted per arm on the same population.
- (E7) FEATURE FIDELITY: live features mirror the harvest dtypes
  exactly BEFORE probe inference (mass* float16, entropy float32,
  top_p float16 sorted descending, slots int16 sorted-unique
  per-layer -1-padded), assembled in the feature_blocks order
  (mass16, mass32, mass64, mass512, entropy, top_p [, slots
  multi-hot]) — the probes trained on f16-quantized inputs and the
  live path must not feed them f32 variants. Probe inference =
  exported weights applied as float32 logits -> float64 softmax
  (train_probe full_eval semantics). EXPORT SELF-CHECK: the
  exported weights, applied to >= 1000 sampled committed-harvest
  anchors per cell, must reproduce full-eval's pred exactly and
  prob_max within 1e-5 (judgment-call tolerance for CPU-vs-GPU op
  order, pinned now).
- (E8) BYPRODUCT FORMAT: per run, a gitignored directory
  <out>.byproduct/ holding one npz per prompt with per-block arrays
  (anchor absolute position; slots (L, top_n) int16; h_a float16;
  mass16/32/64/512 float16; entropy float32; argmax; top-32 ids +
  probs; gamma_used; stop position 0/1/2; extend flag; accepted
  count; consult signals for BOTH signal families) and
  per-drafted-position arrays padded to gamma_max=6 (proposed
  token, accepted flag, analytic 1 - TV(p_j, q_j)); the run meta
  records per-file sha256s at summary time (harvest convention: raw
  gitignored, meta committed). Every field is a quantity the loop
  already computes or reads from passive hooks — the READ-ONLY
  constraint is structural (no extra forwards; no RNG: tap topk,
  probe inference, and scheduler decisions are deterministic).
- (E9) LIVE-TAP FIDELITY RIDER + TOLERANCE MAPPING (mapping pinned
  NOW, before any comparison data exists — the S3 pattern): the
  rider compares, at >= 16 sampled (prompt, block) anchors of a
  CALIBRATION live run (rng seed 100; val prompts; NOT verdict
  data) with >= 4 anchors from REJECTION-TERMINATED blocks (topped
  up by resampling if the draw falls short — the registered
  must-include), the live verify-forward capture (slots, mass512,
  entropy, argmax; h_a reported) against a fresh batch-1
  teacher-forced full forward over the exact token prefix that
  anchor row conditions on (prompt + emitted tokens through the
  anchor position; with proposal coupling this contains no rejected
  content) using the harvest-style last-position capture. Metrics
  verbatim from R1 (per-layer slot-set overlap, mass512 L-inf
  stored-f16-vs-f32, entropy |delta|, argmax-with-gap; h_a L-inf
  REPORTED, non-gating). CALIBRATION first: the same comparison on
  30 aligned + 30 off-by-one misaligned anchors. MAPPING,
  mechanical: MASS_LINF_MAX and ENTROPY_ABS_MAX = 3.0x the
  calibrated aligned max; SLOT_OVERLAP_MIN = ceil((aligned
  min-overlap minimum + misaligned max-overlap maximum) / 2);
  ARGMAX_GAP = MASS_LINF_MAX (the S1/S3 pattern; this mapping
  reproduces both prior lineages' constants). Constants land in the
  rider by dated amendment after calibration, refuse-until-pinned
  guard retained; a FAIL quarantines the live instrument under the
  S3 cycle bound (no widening absent a named mechanism + critic
  review); rider rng lineage starts 0, +1 per rerun.
- (E10) CONTAINMENT RIDER (the "READ-ONLY, D-6 preserved" empirical
  check): vanilla arm, 10 val prompts, seed 100, three runs —
  instruments ON, instruments OFF, instruments OFF rerun. If OFF vs
  OFF-rerun is bit-identical in emitted ids, the bar is
  BIT-IDENTITY of ON vs OFF (passive hooks may not change one bit);
  else the bar is |mean acceptance delta(ON, OFF)| <= max per-prompt
  |delta(OFF, OFF-rerun)| + 0.005, with first-divergence positions
  reported. Both branches pinned now; which branch is armed is
  decided by the OFF/OFF outcome and disclosed.
- (E11) INSTRUMENT CHANGE SCOPE: the scheduler/live-tap/byproduct
  machinery enters spec_decode_prompt behind optional parameters
  DEFAULTING OFF; the default path must remain byte-identical at
  the code level (the train_probe full_eval precedent) — asserted
  by CPU tests where testable. The K-3 arm runner is a NEW tool
  (tools/run_k3_arms.py) with the house meta/state/resume/overwrite

  with the prefill active (cross-arm comparability), including arms
  1 and 5 (scheduler inert: fixed gamma 4 / 6).
- (E12) DATED AMENDMENT (2026-09-02, on the critic's stage-E round,
  BEFORE any stage-E run, calibration artifact, or export exists):
  (i) BLOCK-1 CONSULT EXCLUSION (critic blocker): the arc's
  "offsets 2-3 = drafted positions 1-2" equation holds for every
  block whose anchor produced an emitted token and FAILS for block
  1 — the prefill anchor's offset-1 token IS drafted position 1
  (label_index: offset 1 is the token sampled from the anchor's own
  p_a), so a block-1 consult would compare the off2 probe against
  an offset-1 token: a one-position skew that hits the probe arms
  only (arm 2's signal is offset-free) and sits off-registration.
  Pinned fix: NO adaptive arm consults on block 1 — STOP and EXTEND
  are disabled there and the block rides at gamma_base, uniformly
  across arms 2-4 (D-11 skeleton matching forbids a per-arm

  (byproduct row 0 — OQ-15 data), and E5's materialization

  probes trained on temperature-1.0 harvest features and nothing

  harvest temperature, the runner refuses an instruments-on run

  constant (0.10) is TIGHTER than the 3.0x mapping would give

  checked for mass and entropy too (the 3.0x rule is
  self-referential under a systematic live-capture error; only
  overlap has a misaligned-informed floor), and the rider payload

  (shared-run disclosure). (v) CARRY INTO THE FINDING: the E2
  abstain semantics sit in tension with D-7's letter ("excluded
  from both sides of any bucket argmax") while satisfying its
  purpose — no gate ever fires on or because of glue; and realized
  stop/extend rates sit below the nominal quantile levels because
  thresholds materialize on all consulting blocks' signal

  (glue-majority anchors) — both named in the eventual finding.

STAGE-E TOLERANCE AMENDMENT (dated 2026-09-02, AFTER the calibration
evidence results/real/k3_tap_calibration.json existed and BEFORE the
rider ran; every constant is the E9 mapping applied mechanically to
that payload — no number here was chosen):
- OVERLAP STATISTIC, operational (E12(iv) duty): per anchor, the MIN
  over the four tapped layers of |stored top-32-unique slot set ∩
  recomputed set|; the aligned band is the distribution of that
  per-anchor min (calibrated 27..32 of 32); the misaligned side
  enters the mapping as the MAX over off-by-one control anchors of
  the same per-anchor min (calibrated 13).
- CONSTANTS (mechanical): SLOT_OVERLAP_MIN = ceil((27 + 13) / 2)
  = 20. MASS_LINF_MAX = 3.0 x 0.03698068857192993 =
  0.11094206571578979. ENTROPY_ABS_MAX = 3.0 x 0.1302955150604248 =
  0.3908865451812744. ARGMAX_GAP = MASS_LINF_MAX. Exact products are
  used, not rounded values — rounding would be a choice the mapping
  does not license (the S1/S3 lineages rounded; disclosed
  difference).
- SEPARATION CHECK (E12(iv) duty, both readings from the payload):
  MASS separates cleanly — misaligned minimum 0.2140 sits 1.9x ABOVE
  the tolerance and 5.8x above the aligned max. ENTROPY DOES NOT
  separate at the minimum — misaligned min 0.0063 < aligned max
  0.1303 (adjacent positions can share near-identical distributions;
  the S1 calibration hit the same caveat) — so entropy alone could
  pass a misaligned read and the AND-structure is load-bearing:
  OVERLAP is the sharp discriminator (misaligned max 13 << threshold
  20 << aligned min 27). The misaligned entropy p50 (0.790) still
  sits 2x above the tolerance — entropy rejects the TYPICAL
  misaligned anchor; only its tail overlaps. Stated per the E12(iv) self-referentiality
  warning: under a hypothetical systematic live-capture error the 3x
  mass/entropy rules widen with the error; the overlap floor is the
  misaligned-informed guard.
- SAMPLE: 30 aligned + 30 off-by-one anchors, 15/30 rejection-
  terminated (the phantom-context hazard class is well represented).
  h_a L-inf (reported, non-gating): aligned 0.125..0.75 in f16
  final-norm units — recorded for OQ-15/OQ-16 consumers, no gate.
- CYCLE BOUND armed at these values (S3 pattern): a rider FAIL
  quarantines the live instrument with NO further widening absent a
  named mechanism + critic review; rider rng lineage starts 0, +1
  per rerun. Constants land in sideband/real/k3_tap_rider.py with
  the refuse-until-pinned guard retained (re-arms if reverted).

THRESHOLD-SEARCH REGISTRATION (frontier pruning + selection
completion; dated 2026-09-02, BEFORE the B_ref/materialization run,
the search driver tool, or any tuning eval exists. Amendment #1 pins
the objective, grid, and primary tie-break; E5/E12 pin the
materialization; this block pins WHICH grid cells are evaluated and
the residual tie-break, and owns the argument's limits):
- COST BASIS (measured, results/real/k3_tapcal_arm1.stats.jsonl just
  read): one val eval = a live 30-prompt run, 347.0 s of compute
  (mean 11.57 s/prompt) — offline replay is invalid because
  scheduling changes trajectories; exhaustive 19x19 = 361 evals/arm
  x 3 arms is ruled out on cost.
- STRUCTURAL ARGUMENT: at a FIXED stop level, lowering the extend
  level (more extends) weakly raises BOTH realized drafted-per-
  emitted and tokens/call in expectation — EXTEND is the only
  emitted-count channel and the committed accepted-length
  distribution already showed the always-extend direction raises
  both (the gaming arithmetic). Hence the best FEASIBLE point at
  each stop level is the LOWEST extend level whose realized val
  budget <= B_ref (its frontier point); off-frontier feasible
  points are weakly dominated in expectation.
- PROCEDURE (pinned, deterministic, IDENTICAL for arms 2/3/4): for
  each of the 19 stop levels in ascending order, find the minimal
  feasible extend level by bisection on REALIZED val budget over
  the ascending extend-level list (budget nonincreasing in extend
  level per the argument): warm-start check first — evaluate the
  PREVIOUS stop level's minimal feasible extend level (1 eval; the
  first stop level bisects the full range); if feasible, bisect at
  or below it, else bisect above it — deterministic, arm-kind
  agnostic, worst case 1 + ceil(log2(19)) = 6 evals per stop level,
  worst case <= 114 per arm (~11.0 h at the measured 347.0 s basis;
  warm-start + dedupe typically far fewer — critic arithmetic fix
  pre-commit: an earlier "~95" contradicted the per-level bound).
  Every selected point is backed by an ACTUAL eval
  (no interpolation). DEDUPE allowed: grid points whose materialized
  threshold values are identical reuse the earlier eval's result,
  recorded as such. FEASIBILITY = realized val drafted-per-emitted
  <= B_ref EXACTLY (Amendment #1 harmonization; the verdict-time
  epsilon stays the design's only tolerance). A stop level with no
  feasible extend level (even 0.95 infeasible) is EXCLUDED; if ALL
  stop levels are excluded for an arm, its tuning is
  FAILED-INFEASIBLE and it runs at the grid's maximal-stop
  minimal-extend corner (probe arms: stop level 0.05 / extend 0.95;
  arm 2: stop 0.95 / extend 0.95 — the direction inversion, E3),
  disclosed in the finding. LABEL (critic): the corner is a
  COMPARABILITY FALLBACK outside Amendment #1's constrained-max
  frame — the constrained max does not exist on an empty feasible
  set — and carries no feasibility guarantee of its own; the
  verdict-time pairwise budget guard remains the enforcement if its
  realized budget runs high. It is structurally near-unreachable
  (stopping pushes budget toward 1.0, so this corner is the grid's
  minimum-expected-budget point); if even it is infeasible, B_ref
  itself is suspect — a named tripwire.
- SELECTION (completes Amendment #1's tie-break): over the
  evaluated frontier points, maximize val tokens/call; ties break
  to lower realized val budget (Amendment #1), residual exact-float
  ties to lower stop level then lower extend level (pinned here).
- HONESTY CLAUSES: monotonicity is an expectation-level argument;
  realized 30-prompt evals are noisy and adjacent levels can yield
  identical trajectories (a threshold change binds only when some
  block's signal falls between the quantile values). A noise-misled
  bisection still returns a FEASIBLE, deterministic selection — the
  risk is UNDER-optimization of that arm, never gate invalidity;
  the identical procedure runs for all three adaptive arms, so
  pruning cannot asymmetrically favor the telemetry arm. The
  registered claim at freeze time: each arm's selection is the
  constrained max OVER ITS EVALUATED SET, the frontier argument
  being the pinned reason that set suffices.
- MECHANICS: B_ref = the vanilla-arm val run's POOLED drafted-per-
  emitted at seed 0 (the E5 materialization run — a NEW run; the
  seed-100 calibration run is NOT it), frozen at first read before
  any adaptive eval. The search runs through a driver tool (to be
  built and critic-gated) that loads the models ONCE and evaluates
  grid points in-process via the committed run_k3_arms machinery's
  spec_decode path on the 30 val prompts at seed 0; every eval is
  logged (arm, levels, materialized values, realized tokens/call,
  realized budget) to results/real/k3_threshold_search_arm{N}.json
  with a sha-headed state file for resume (committed evidence).
  The frozen thresholds land as results/real/k3_thresholds_arm{N}
  .json consumed by run_k3_arms --thresholds unchanged. DRIVER-GATE
  CARRIES (critic, binding on the tool's own critic round): (1) a
  selection-time assert that the chosen pair's LOGGED eval
  satisfies budget <= B_ref (the registered sentence,
  machine-checked); (2) per-eval fresh spawn(0, n) generators and
  identical prompt encoding asserted in-process — model-loaded-once
  must not leak RNG or cache state across evals.

DATED ERRATUM (2026-09-02, after the three searches completed and
were critic-recomputed, BEFORE any verdict-population run or read):
the honesty-clause sentence "each arm's selection is the constrained
max OVER ITS EVALUATED SET" is FALSIFIED by arm 2's own committed
log (k3_threshold_search_arm2.json.state.jsonl): the logged eval at
(stop q0.15, extend q0.7) is feasible (budget 1.263487 <= B_ref)
with val tokens/call 3.124012 > the selected (q0.25, q0.5) cell's
3.096891. The frontier restriction dropped it because realized
tokens/call INVERTED at that stop level (the frontier cell
(q0.15, q0.65) realized 3.082790) — the structural argument above
is expectation-level and failed in realization there. Arms 3 and 4
did achieve their evaluated-set max, so the realized asymmetry runs
AGAINST arm 2, i.e. ANTI-CONSERVATIVE for the K-3 gate: the arm-2
comparator may be under-tuned by up to ~0.027 val tokens/call
(~0.004 acceptance-equivalent at F-12's ~6.2 coupling). Critic
recompute (2026-09-02, 20k paired per-prompt bootstrap resamples of
the two committed eval rows, identical spawn(0,30) streams): gap
CI95 [-0.129, +0.177], P(gap>0) = 0.62; the alternative cell's own
feasibility survives resampling only at P = 0.83 — the registered
noise scenario, not a demonstrated real effect. THE SELECTION
STANDS (a post-hoc switch would be procedure-shopping onto a
noisier cell); the sentence's "pruning cannot asymmetrically favor
the telemetry arm" holds only in expectation — disclosed, and
carried into the finding.
- PRE-REGISTERED CONTINGENCY (pinned now, before any verdict data
  exists, neutralizing the anti-conservative residual): IF the
  verdict-time arm-4-vs-arm-2 pairwise leg PASSES its registered
  criteria (CI95 lower > 0, point >= +0.062, budget guard) AND its
  point delta clears the bar by LESS THAN +0.031 tokens/call
  (0.005 acceptance-equivalent; chosen to cover the ~0.027
  residual), THEN one additional arm-2 verdict-population run
  executes at the alternative thresholds — the arm-2 state line's
  materialized values at (stop q0.15, extend q0.7), written to
  results/real/k3_thresholds_arm2_alt.json with selection_label
  ROBUSTNESS_ALT before that run — at the same seed as the verdict
  runs it accompanies (seed 0; seed 1 only under the void
  semantics). The arm-4-vs-arm-2 leg is then evaluated against
  BOTH arm-2 variants under identical criteria and the WIN stands
  only if it holds against both. The contingency does NOT fire
  when the leg fails (an under-tuned comparator only strengthens a
  failure), adds no other analysis, and reads no other signal.
- SEARCH-OUTCOME DISCLOSURES (carried into the finding): (i) arm
  3's tuning is DEGENERATE — every frontier point sits at extend
  level 0.05, the frontier tokens/call span (3.1327..3.1477) is
  far inside single-eval noise (~+/-0.15 per the bootstrap above),
  and the winner (stop q0.95) sits on the grid boundary;
  deterministic and feasible per registration, effectively
  arbitrary within noise. (ii) arm 4's stop-q0.15 exclusion rides
  margins of +1.083e-4 (its e0 cell, 1.2771476991265807 vs B_ref)
  to +2.87e-3 (e18), and realized budget there INCREASES with
  extend level — a second realized inversion of the structural
  argument; outcome-irrelevant (that level's best tokens/call,
  3.091, is far below the selected 3.192). (iii) POSITIVE (critic):
  bit-identical per-prompt matrices across evals with DISTINCT
  materialized thresholds (arm 3 s9-s15; arm 2 s5 e0-e4) confirm
  per-eval RNG freshness at per-prompt-counter granularity —
  driver-gate carry #2 observed holding in production.

VOID EXECUTION (dated 2026-09-02 evening, written AFTER the seed-0
verdict runs completed and the budget guard was evaluated, BEFORE
any quarantined gate metric was read):
- BREACH FACTS (budget columns only, as the quarantine permits):

### Phase 5 — Hardware premise memo
Goal: the economics. Sideband width vs recovery (real analog of F-5), sidecar
latency vs draft-loop budget, and where such a device would sit (MoE/offload
regimes only — D-1 killed the dense-resident story). Wall-clock requires the
KV-crop fast path (marked TODO in hf_specdec); acceptance numbers do not.
Exit: a one-page yes/no with measured inputs.
DATED NOTE 2026-10-16: "marked TODO in hf_specdec" was true in the initial
commit (21b9010, 2026-08-29) and stale from b1dae57 later that day: the
adapter crops KV caches by default. What wall-clock still requires is a
benchmark harness, never built (DECISIONS.md D-9, dated note 2026-10-16).

PHASE-5 SKELETON + K-3 BARS REGISTERED (2026-09-01, after F-18,
BEFORE any K-3 actuator experiment exists): docs/ECONOMICS.md is the
memo's registered skeleton — measured-inputs table, derived sideband
widths (S3 513-768 bits/token vs SD^2's 65,536 bits/position), the
two deployment lanes (A: software index-stream steering in MoE
serving, no hardware premise, K-6 moot; B: the memory-side device,
which additionally needs a defended values-cannot-cross boundary),
and the PINNED BARS: K-3 WIN = paired acceptance deltas on the 210
committed prompts at identical seeds vs ALL THREE comparators
(vanilla + both D-11 free arms); the gating delta is the MINIMUM of
the three, which must have CI95 lower > 0, point >= +0.010, analytic
concordant (anchors: exceeds F-14's dead-actuator oracle-ceiling
CI-upper +0.0069 at its tested coarse-k cell; ~2x the harness CI
half-width). Lane-B materiality: the OPERATIONAL BAR is point
acceptance delta >= +0.044 (~+0.27 tokens/call via the F-12-measured
~6.2 coupling; the motivating "25% of SD^2" label mixes bases and is
~37% like-for-like — the acceptance number gates, the memo carries
the disclosure) PLUS the K-6 boundary argument, else Lane B concedes
per K-6's own text. Lane A's claims are the narrower input and the
unclaimed research cell — K-6's device question does not arise
there, but SD^2-in-software remains the in-lane alternative (owned
in the memo). S2 is settled as Lane-B breadth, NOT on the K-3
critical path. The bars may not be amended after any K-3 result is
read (dated pre-result amendments allowed). The K-3 kill rule in
Phase 4 above stands unchanged, as does Phase 4's block condition
(an actuator with a non-negative free arm) — these bars do not
unblock it.

THE QUESTION, two-staged: (I) does the telemetry stream carry

TERMINAL-OUTCOME PARTITION (exhaustive; the decidability pin's
payload, pinned before anything runs):
- WIN: Stage I PASSES and Stage C passes EVERY leg of the unchanged
  gate. A WIN ends the K-3 lane (hard-stop clause). A WIN below the
  Lane-B operational bar (+0.044 acceptance-equivalent) is Lane-A
  ONLY, per the memo — the label applies to this arc as it did to
  Attempt #1.
- INFORMATION-CEILING NULL: Stage I FAILS (its one criterion below;
  CI straddles of zero read as FAIL). OQ-16 is SKIPPED and the K-3
  lane STOPS.
- CONVERSION-MODE NULL: Stage I PASSES and Stage C resolves NOT-WIN
  (any leg fails statistically, or the budget guard fails after the
  void semantics exhaust). Hands off to OQ-16 per the amendment.
- NOISE-ANCHOR CLASSIFICATION ROLE, pinned: the equal-dims
  alignment-destroyed head IS the matched-capacity free-baseline
  head of the amendment's skip condition. Lift that does not exceed
  it (anchor-explained lift) is INFORMATION-CEILING NULL.
- LEDGER CONSTRAINT (c) SUPERSESSION (dated 2026-09-03, pre-commit,
  critic blocker): OQ-15's ledgered constraint (c) reads "telemetry
  must add precision-at-coverage beyond it [the FREE-features
  predictor], with the F-16-style equal-dims noise anchor". That
  sentence's GATE role is superseded here, before any data: the
  gate is the noise-twin MSE comparison below, because (i) F-16's
  MEASURED dilution (-0.0045..+3.3e-5 per +2048 dims) can fake a
  null on a TEL-vs-FREE gate — the committed reason the equal-dims
  arm exists — and (ii) the pooled-MSE regression readout is the
  variance-reduced form of the same question on the amendment-named
  analytic target. The REJECTED alternative reading, named: gate =
  TEL-vs-FREE with the anchor only classifying the mode. Constraint
  (c)'s substance is retained: the FREE predictor runs alongside
  (delta_free, reported and carried), and precision-at-coverage is
  computed and reported (the binary sidebar, both tails). This
  supersession may not be re-litigated after any Stage-I readout.
- CEILING-NULL MEANING, bounded (critic blocker; the F-16/F-18
  asymmetry sentence carried): the shifted-slots twin could in
  principle carry aligned-equivalent signal (prompt-level telemetry
  correlates of difficulty), which could only SHRINK delta_noise —
  an underestimate channel feeding the null branch. The
  information-ceiling null therefore claims: no BLOCK-ALIGNED
  acceptance-relevant information above free signals plus
  prompt-level telemetry statistics — not "the stream carries
  nothing". The skip stands on that reading (a stream whose
  acceptance signal is not block-aligned cannot fund either
  registered supervision, both of which read the block anchor);
  delta_free and the per-feature-set test MSEs are reported, so the
  prompt-level-signal world is detectable in the evidence and must
  be discussed in the finding if delta_free and delta_noise
  disagree in sign.
- ANY outcome the above cannot classify defaults to
  INFORMATION-CEILING NULL (the amendment's conservative branch).
- A Stage-C that never runs (Stage I passed; execution never
  authorized) is NOT an outcome: the lane stays OPEN at fold-back
  #1, unresolved. No classification may be claimed from it. If the
  user formally abandons the lane in that state, a dated ABANDONED
  note records it; OQ-16 may still not run (it is authorized only
  by a conversion-mode null). LIMBO DISPOSITION (critic advisory,
  pinned): if the gitignored byproduct raws are lost before Stage I
