STAGE I — INFORMATION (CPU-only; committed-evidence inputs; no GPU,
no new model runs; supersedes the OQ-15 ledger's CHEAP PILOT, whose
purpose — gating a paired-harvest spend — is moot because the
registered byproduct amendment already collected the paired data
for free):
- DATA: the arm-1 (vanilla gamma-4) byproduct raws of the two
  verdict runs (seeds 0 and 1; 210 prompts each) are the gate data —
  the only runs that are on-policy for a fixed gamma-4 schedule.
  The arm-1 val and tapcal byproducts (30 prompts each) join TRAIN
  ONLY. Arms 2-4 byproducts are EXCLUDED (adaptive stopping selects
  the drafted-position mix — the composition confound the memo's
  owned deviation names); arm-5 byproducts feed ONLY the Stage-C
  offset-5 head below. Block row 0 (the prefill anchor) is INCLUDED
  — E12 marks it OQ-15 data; its consult exclusion was a
  probe-OFFSET artifact and no probe features are consumed here.
  The loader MUST verify each npz's sha256 against the committed
  run summary before reading and refuse on mismatch (the raws are
  gitignored; the committed shas are what binds them).
- SPLIT, pinned: prompt-level over the 210 verdict prompts; both
  seed-runs of a prompt share its split; numpy
  default_rng(15).permutation(210) -> first 126 TRAIN, next 42 VAL,
  last 42 TEST. Val/tapcal prompts are TRAIN-only rows.
- TARGET, primary (per the byproduct amendment's naming): the
  per-drafted-position ANALYTIC acceptance 1 - TV(p_j, q_j), a
  regression target in [0,1], defined at every drafted position
  (not survival-conditioned). Offsets j = 1..4 (the on-policy
  schedule's positions).
- FEATURES (E7 dtypes; assembly must reproduce
  scheduler.probe_input's layout on the shared blocks, asserted by
  tests against probe_input itself — the D-3 discipline):
  - FREE(j): mass16/32/64/512 + entropy + top_p (657 dims, the
    committed (a)-family) + q_sig[0:min(j,2)] (the draft-confidence
    consult signals — SpecDec++'s feature class; q_sig[k] = q(x_{k+1})
    is known pre-verify, so offset-j availability is q_sig up to
    position min(j,2)).
  - TEL(j): FREE(j) + slots multi-hot (2048 dims, probe_input's
    slots layout) — the (c)-family analog. Column order is
    probe_input's (core [, slots]) with q_sig appended last —
    ridge-immaterial under per-feature standardization, pinned for
    reproducibility.
  - NOISE(j): FREE(j) + alignment-destroyed slots multi-hot: within
    each (prompt, run), block b takes block (b + 17) mod n_blocks's
    slot vector (F-16's shift recipe: per-prompt-run slot statistics
    preserved, anchor alignment destroyed, dims equal to TEL).
    Self-mapping prompt-runs (n_blocks in {1, 17}) are counted over
    the TEST prompt-runs the gate consumes and reported (the F-16
    sliver disclosure).
  - probe_pred/probe_conf and h are NOT consumed (h is OQ-16's
    input; probe features would import the E2/E12 offset semantics
    this design does not need).
- HEADS, pinned: per-offset ridge regression, closed-form float64
  (no SGD, no training seed — the run is deterministic given the
  split constant), features standardized to TRAIN mean/std
  (zero-variance features stay zero), intercept unpenalized,
  predictions CLIPPED to [0,1]. Per-head lambda from the pinned grid
  {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1, 10} by VAL pooled MSE, exact ties
  breaking toward the LARGER lambda (more regularized) — the ONLY
  selection DOF in Stage I. 12 gate heads (3 feature sets x 4
  offsets); the reported-only binary heads apply the same lambda
  rule on their own target.
- GATE READOUT, pinned (ONE criterion): on TEST prompts only,
  pooled over offsets 1-4 and both seed-runs, with ONE CLUSTER PER
  PROMPT (a prompt's two runs pool into its cluster — same content,
  correlated, must not split):
    delta_noise = pooled MSE(NOISE heads) - pooled MSE(TEL heads)
  via stats.paired_cluster_delta_ci (successes_x = per-cluster
  summed squared error — valid input because clipped predictions on
  a [0,1] target give per-position SE <= 1; trials = per-cluster
  drafted-position count; n_boot 2000, seed 0, alpha 0.05 — the
  committed estimator, unmodified). STAGE I PASSES iff delta_noise
  CI95 lower bound > 0. Anything else — straddle, zero, negative —
  is the INFORMATION-CEILING NULL.
- REPORTED, not gating (required computations, carried into the
  finding whichever way they land): delta_free = pooled MSE(FREE) -
  pooled MSE(TEL), same recipe (the deployable-net-value reading:
  did telemetry survive its own +2048-dim dilution); per-offset
  deltas for both comparisons; each head's TEST MSE against the
  TRAIN-mean trivial baseline; the classification variant (binary
  accept flag on REACHED positions only — survival-conditioned,
  labeled per D-9 — same features, linear-probability ridge, AUC
  and precision at coverage 0.20 for BOTH tails — predicted-accept
  and predicted-reject, the latter being ledger (c)'s
  failure-predictor tail — the D2 operating point). Per-head TEST
  MSEs land in the summary alongside the per-offset deltas.
  DISCLOSED: a delta_noise pass with a delta_free fail still PASSES
  Stage I — information exists and the ceiling branch may not claim
  it; whether it nets out deployably is Stage C's question, where
  the FREE-head arm carries D-5 at the policy level.
- NO magnitude bar at Stage I, pinned reasoning: the amendment's
  skip condition is existence-flavored ("carries no
  acceptance-relevant information above free signals"), and the
  magnitude burden sits at Stage C's unchanged bars. The cost this
  leaves open (a real-but-tiny margin authorizing a GPU stage) is
  owned: Stage C is additionally user-gated.
- EVIDENCE: results/real/oq15_stage1.json (summary) +
  .state.jsonl (per-prompt, per-head squared-error/count rows —
  the critic's recompute surface, sha-headered to the byproduct
  bindings) + meta before the run; tool = tools/train_outcome_head.py
  (meta/overwrite house conventions; CPU-only, no torch import).
  Critic recompute BEFORE the Stage-I outcome is treated as
  decided; the registered run itself does not start until this
  registration is committed.

STAGE C — CONVERSION (GPU; runs ONLY on a Stage-I PASS; execution

  under population difficulty the way arm 2's q-signals did (their

  outcome is a decidable conversion-mode null — itself informative

  (n_boot 2000, seed 0); WIN iff for EVERY comparator in {C1, C2,
  C3}: CI95 lower > 0 AND point >= +0.062 AND C4
  drafted-per-emitted <= comparator's + 0.01 (pairwise guard).
  Analytic estimand REPORTED not gating (the memo's owned deviation

- VOID SEMANTICS: Attempt #1's, verbatim — guard breach at verdict

- DEFERRED CONSTANTS (the E9 pattern): the materialized quantile

STAGE-I POST-GATE DIAGNOSTIC DI-1 — STALE-TARGET CONTROL (dated
2026-09-03, registered AFTER the Stage-I gate was read (PASS,
delta_noise +0.0007634988041307618 CI95 [+0.000308, +0.001215],
critic-recomputed bit-exact with a byte-identical deterministic
rerun) and BEFORE this control runs — the P1 post-hoc pattern:
cells, readout, and conclusion labels pinned first. NON-CRITERION:
the mechanical PASS stands regardless; this control prices what the
PASS MEANS in the finding and in the user's Stage-C cost decision):
- CONFOUND, named (critic recompute-round advisory): TEL's slot
  dims are SAME-ANCHOR telemetry, partially linearly redundant with
  the same anchor's 657 free dims (mass512 profiles the same
  distribution the slot tier reads), while NOISE's shifted slots
  are only prompt-level redundant. Under near-edge-lambda ridge,
  redundant extra dims can cost less estimation variance than
  quasi-independent ones REGARDLESS of outcome content — an
  OVERESTIMATE channel for delta_noise. The registered CEILING-NULL
  MEANING paragraph covers only the opposite (underestimate)
  channel; the gate margin (+0.00076) is ~21% of the measured total
  slot-dim cost (NOISE-vs-FREE +0.00362), small enough that this
  channel could carry a real share.
- CONTROL: rerun the identical Stage-I pipeline with each
  (run, prompt)'s TARGETS (analytic AND acc_flags rows) replaced by
  a seeded random permutation of that prompt-run's own block rows;
  features untouched. All block alignment between ANY arm's
  features and the target is destroyed while prompt-level
  statistics are preserved: a surviving TEL-vs-NOISE margin on the
  stale target is fitting-cost artifact, not information. Donor
  permutation per (run, prompt): default_rng(perm_seed * 1000000 +
  run_index * 10000 + prompt_id) with run_index the position in the
  registered run list — per-row isolated RNG, identical across the

  run (the artifact channel includes selection).
- CELLS: primary perm_seed 0 -> results/real/oq15_stage1_rotcheck.json
  (+ state/meta); replicate perm_seed 1 -> ..._rotcheck_r.json.
  Readout: the stale delta_noise' (pooled, same estimator).
- CONCLUSION LABELS, pinned now (judgment-call thresholds, F-13
  labeling; d_live = +0.0007634988041307618, half = +0.000382):
  INFORMATION-CONFIRMED iff the primary stale CI95 upper <
  0.5*d_live; ARTIFACT-DOMINANT iff the primary stale point >=
  0.5*d_live; ARTIFACT-NOT-EXCLUDED otherwise. Exhaustive and
  mutually exclusive. The replicate is reported; if its label
  disagrees with the primary's, the more artifact-leaning label
  carries. SCALE CAVEAT, disclosed: the stale target's predictable
  variance is lower than the live target's, so fitting-cost
  magnitudes need not transfer exactly — the control bounds the
  channel's presence, not its exact live share. (2026-09-03
  post-run note, disclosed: in the pathological case where a
  bootstrap point >= half while the CI upper < half — which did NOT
  occur in any cell — ARTIFACT-DOMINANT takes precedence; noted for
  reuse only, no bearing on these cells.)
- SEED-SPREAD EXTENSION (dated 2026-09-03, critic-suggested at the
  DI-1 verification round, registered BEFORE running; REPORTED-ONLY

- LIVE SCORING PATH, pinned: HeadScorer (CPU, sideband.outcome_head)
  computes a_hat_i = clip([1, (x - mu_i)/sd_i] @ w_i, 0, 1) in
  float64, x = core ++ q_sig[0:min(i,2)], where core is EXACTLY the
  LiveReader's probe_input vector (x["a"] for FREE, x["c"] for TEL —
  the same committed assembler Stage I trained through; AnchorRead
  gains a read-only field carrying it). S_j = prod(a_hat_1..j).
  STOP consult j in {1,2}: fires iff S_j < tau_stop[j] (strict, as
  registered). EXTEND: fires iff S_4 * a_hat_5 >= tau_ext. Block 1
  never consults (structural, uniform). Directions note: higher
  tau_stop = stop more, higher tau_ext = extend less — so the
  FAILED-INFEASIBLE comparability corner for head arms is
  (stop 0.95, extend 0.95), the arm-2 orientation.

  pooled TRAIN rows only; every MSE below is in standardized
  units; the trivial train-mean predictor's TEST MSE is reported
  (approx. 1 by construction, not exactly — its exact value is the
  R^2 denominator).
- MODEL: multi-output closed-form ridge on [1, X_std] (the
  committed ridge_fit with matrix RHS; intercept unpenalized;
  float64). ONE DOF: lambda from RECON_LAMBDA_GRID = (1e-2, 1e-1,
  1, 10, 1e2, 1e3, 1e4, 1e5) on pooled VAL standardized MSE, tie
  -> larger lambda. The grid is WIDENED vs Stage I's after three
  consecutive grid-edge selections (F-19/F-20/freeze); an edge
  selection here is a pinned disclosure duty, not a stopper.
- ESTIMAND: pooled TEST standardized MSE per arm; deltas via
  stats.paired_ratio_delta_ci (n_boot 2000, seed 0, alpha 0.05)
  with num = per-cluster summed squared error, den = per-cluster
  position count (rows x 4096, identical across arms). VALIDITY
  NOTE, pinned: Stage I's paired_cluster_delta_ci requires
  successes <= trials (its [0,1]-target validity condition);
  standardized squared errors are unbounded per position, so the
  ratio form — the same estimand when denominators are identical,
  already committed for E6 — is the registered function. Never
  re-implemented (D-3).
- STALE-TARGET CONTROL — GATING, the F-20 method lesson baked into
  the criterion instead of bolted on after: 5 permutation seeds
  (0, 1, 2, 3, 4), the DI-1 recipe verbatim — target rows permuted
  within each (run, prompt) by default_rng(seed * 1_000_000 +
  run_index * 10_000 + pid).permutation(n_blocks), features
  untouched, lambda RE-SELECTED inside every control. The
  prompt-level split means every permutation maps TRAIN rows to
  TRAIN rows, so feature moments and Gram matrices are identical
  across variants — the implementation may share them (asserted,
  not assumed), and ONE pipeline invocation computes the live gate
  and all five controls.
- GATE (all-hold, mechanical, labels pinned):
  leg 1 (existence): delta_noise = MSE(NOISE) - MSE(TEL) with
    CI95 lower > 0 AND point > stale_mean + 3 * stale_sd (ddof=1
    over the five stale delta_noise points) AND point > max(stale
    points);
  leg 2 (deployability): delta_free = MSE(FREE) - MSE(TEL) with
    CI95 lower > 0.
  STAGE-R PASS iff both legs hold; leg-1 failure ->
  RECONSTRUCTION-CEILING NULL; leg 1 holds and leg 2 fails ->
  RECONSTRUCTION-DILUTION NULL. The summary payload prints exactly
  these strings from exactly these rules.
- READOUTS (REPORTED, not gating): pooled R^2 = 1 - MSE/MSE_trivial

- ARTIFACTS, pinned: results/real/oq16_stage_r.json (summary,

STAGE-R POST-GATE DIAGNOSTIC DR-3 — TELEMETRY ON TOP OF p (dated
2026-09-04, registered AFTER DR-2 was read and its wording critic-
corrected, BEFORE this diagnostic runs; critic-proposed as its
"what would change my mind" on the composition claim; NON-CRITERION
— cannot reclassify the Stage-R branch; committed pre-run):
- QUESTION: DR-2 showed a free encoding of p's top-32 support
  reconstructs h_a at least as well as telemetry. It did NOT show
  the telemetry margin is composed of token identity: TEL and
  FREETOK could carry partly different information netting to a
  tie (FREETOK beats TEL in 59/84 clusters). DR-3 asks directly
  whether telemetry adds block-aligned information ON TOP of p.
- ARMS (inside the DR-1 clipped pipeline, same split/seeds/grid/
  controls; run with --feature-clip --freetok --union so every DR-1
  / DR-2 readout is recomputed alongside): UNION = TEL ++ TOK
  (free 657 ++ slots 2048 ++ hashed top-32 ids 2048 = 4753 dims);
  UNIONNOISE = NOISE ++ TOK (the F-16 alignment-destroyed slot
  block inside the union; equal dims — the dilution-priced anchor
  for the slot block's contribution). The token block is identical
  in both; only the slot block's alignment differs.
- READOUTS (paired_ratio_delta_ci, same recipe; pooled + per
  population + five stale variants): union_vs_freetok =
  MSE(FREETOK) - MSE(UNION); union_vs_unionnoise = MSE(UNIONNOISE)
  - MSE(UNION); union_vs_tel = MSE(TEL) - MSE(UNION) (reported —
  what p adds on top of telemetry, the mirror question).
- LABELS pinned: TELEMETRY-BEYOND-P iff union_vs_freetok pooled
  CI95 lower > 0 AND union_vs_unionnoise pooled CI95 lower > 0
  (block-aligned, dilution-priced information on top of p);
  TELEMETRY-NOT-BEYOND-P otherwise. The MAGNITUDE is carried with
  the label: union_vs_freetok as a fraction of freetok_vs_free
  (+0.1739 under DR-1) — a CI-clear but small addition is reported
  as exactly that.
- HONEST PREDICTION pinned: genuinely open at the sign level with a
  small expected magnitude either way. Two lossy views of the same
  forward pass usually combine to a little more than either alone,
  so a small CI-clear positive union_vs_freetok (order +0.01, i.e.
  ~5% of the free margin) would not surprise; F-16's measured
  dilution (-0.0045..+3e-5 per +2048 dims at identical budget)
  says the anchor may absorb part of it. A union_vs_freetok at or
  above a quarter of the free margin WOULD surprise and would
  reopen the Stage-A telemetry question with a reconstruction-level
  basis. Recorded against whichever lands.
- MEANING FOR THE LANE (pinned now): TELEMETRY-NOT-BEYOND-P
  licenses the strong wording DR-2 could not ("the telemetry
  margin is within what p reveals") and leaves Stage A as a
  telemetry test with no reconstruction-level basis; TELEMETRY-

STAGE-R POST-GATE DIAGNOSTIC DR-4 — THE BETTER-TOKEN-ENCODING
COMPARATOR (dated 2026-09-04, registered AFTER DR-3 was read and its
wording critic-corrected, BEFORE this diagnostic runs; the critic's
"what would change my mind" on DR-3's "beyond p" qualifier; NON-
CRITERION — cannot reclassify the Stage-R branch; committed pre-run;
the LAST reconstruction-level diagnostic on this lane — no DR-5 by
the fold-back-#2 hard-stop discipline):
- QUESTION: DR-3's union margin over FREETOK (+0.065) cannot separate
  slot information that is a function of p's EXACT top-32 (identity
  lost to the ~62-ids-per-bin hash; value-to-id pairing lost by the
  multi-hot) from information beyond p. DR-4 asks whether a BETTER
  deployment-free encoding of p, at the union's dims, recovers that
  margin.
- COMPARATOR ARM: FREETOK2 = FREE (657) ++ TOK_A (the DR-2 block:
  top-32 ids multi-hot, id mod 2048) ++ TOK_B (2048 bins under a
  salted multiplicative hash — Fibonacci hashing, the top 11 bits of
  (id * 2654435761 + 0x9E3779B9) mod 2^32 — with bin VALUE = the
  token's top_p; within-row collisions sum) = 4753 dims = UNION's
  dims. TOK_B carries the two things TOK_A loses: a second,
  independent collision pattern per id (joint identification) and
  the value-to-id pairing. It is deployment-free (p's top-32 ids and
  probabilities are the free core's own inputs). Run inside the
  DR-1/DR-2/DR-3 pipeline (--feature-clip --freetok --union
  --freetok2) so every earlier readout is recomputed alongside; the
  six DR-3 arms must reproduce DR-3 bit-identically (the additivity
  check the critic performs).
- READOUTS (paired_ratio_delta_ci, same recipe; pooled + per
  population + five stale variants): union_vs_freetok2 =
  MSE(FREETOK2) - MSE(UNION) [PRIMARY; equal dims 4753 vs 4753 — the
  same free core and the same TOK_A block; the third 2048-dim block
  is the telemetry slots in one arm and TOK_B in the other: "which
  block is the better addition on top of FREETOK?"];
  freetok2_vs_freetok = MSE(FREETOK) - MSE(FREETOK2) [the
  comparator's TEETH — it must extract more of p than FREETOK or it
  prices nothing]; freetok2_vs_free and tel_vs_freetok2 (reported).
- LABELS pinned (mechanical, recon.dr4_label): COMPARATOR-TOOTHLESS
  iff freetok2_vs_freetok pooled CI95 lower <= 0 (the better encoding
  extracts nothing more of p in the linear family; DR-3's qualified
  statement stands unchanged and "beyond p" stays UNPRICED — reported
  as such, NOT a confirmation); else BEYOND-P CONFIRMED iff
  union_vs_freetok2 pooled CI95 lower > 0 (the telemetry block beats
  a strictly better free encoding block of p at equal dims: the S1
  stream carries block-aligned information about h_a beyond the
  value-paired, two-hash linear encoding of p's top-32 — the
  strongest deployment-free comparator this lane will run); else
  REDUCES-TO-ENCODING (a better free encoding of p recovers the
  union's margin at equal dims: DR-3's "beyond FREETOK's encoding"
  was encoding loss, not information beyond p). MAGNITUDE carried
  with the label: union_vs_freetok2 as a fraction of union_vs_freetok
  (+0.065180 under DR-3) — how much of the DR-3 margin survives the
  better encoding — and freetok2_vs_freetok as a fraction of
  freetok_vs_free (+0.173871).
- HONEST PREDICTION pinned: teeth expected (a second hash plus the
  value pairing should extract more of p; order +0.02..+0.05).
  union_vs_freetok2 expected positive and SMALLER than +0.065: p's
  exact top-32 is a lossy view of h_a in any encoding, and the
  union's slot block was CI-clear against its destroyed anchor, so
  some of its margin should survive. The surprising sides: (i)
  REDUCES-TO-ENCODING (CI lower <= 0) would say the DR-3 margin was
  hash loss; (ii) more than half the DR-3 margin surviving
  (union_vs_freetok2 >= +0.033) would say the better encoding
  recovered little. Recorded against whichever lands. DILUTION NOTE:
  equal dims by count, as the lane's anchors always were (F-16);
  TOK_B is dense-valued where the slot block is multi-hot, so
  dilution parity is by dims, not by block statistics — disclosed,
  not priced.
- MEANING FOR THE LANE (pinned now): BEYOND-P CONFIRMED is the
  reconstruction-level basis a Stage-A telemetry test needs; the
  Stage-A telemetry claim for the freeze becomes UNION-vs-FREETOK2 at
  the actuator (FREETOK2 the mandatory free comparator, superseding
  FREETOK in that role). REDUCES-TO-ENCODING kills the Stage-A
  telemetry test PRE-GPU: the telemetry block is worth no more than a
  free encoding block of p, and the K-2 sentence ("a lossy copy of
  what the decoder already has") holds at the reconstruction level
  with no qualifier; the free-actuator question (whether an SD^2-
  style injection of a FREE reconstruction converts) remains a
  separate, unregistered question for the user. COMPARATOR-
  TOOTHLESS leaves "beyond p" unpriced; the pre-registered
  recommendation is to treat it as NOT confirmed for the Stage-A
  decision (the user decides; no DR-5). No label changes the
  STAGE-R PASS classification or licenses any conversion-level
  claim.
- ARTIFACTS: results/real/oq16_stage_r_dr4.json (+ sha-headed state,
  meta; .gitignore negation added pre-run). Instrument: the
  --freetok2 mode (refuses the registered out; requires --union);
  recon.tokb_bins / tokb_block / freetok2_features / dr4_label; the
  synthetic e2e test pins the wiring and the label mechanics (the
  CONFIRMED cell on a value-paired construction and the TOOTHLESS
  cell on the token-free one), NOT modes-OFF bit-identity across
  code versions (the DR-3 erratum's lesson) — that is the critic's
  dr3 -> dr4 recompute.

- ACTUATOR, pinned: SD^2's "merged" mechanism from their public code
  (docs/PRIOR_ART.md dated correction 2026-09-04): per drafter layer l
  the MLP computes down(act(gate(x)) * (up(x) + delta_l)) — a forward
  hook on HF LlamaMLP.up_proj adding delta_l is exactly that (critic-
  verified against transformers 4.57.3's LlamaMLP.forward) — with
  delta = adapter(h), adapter = LayerNorm(4096) -> U (4096 x 512) ->
  V_l (512 x 8192) per layer, all 16 layers, V zero-initialised (a
  no-op until trained). OWNED DEVIATIONS from SD^2, disclosed: (i) a
  rank-512 factorisation of their full-rank 4096 x (8192*16) map —
  box memory (537M parameters plus AdamW states do not fit beside
  both models in 12 GB; 69M do); (ii) the DRAFTER STAYS FROZEN —
  SD^2 fully fine-tunes it and calls that step critical, frozen-
  drafter steering being their weaker ablation — so this actuator is
  weaker than SD^2's by construction, which is why the ORACLE-CEILING
  rung exists; (iii) the steering vector is the verifier's final-norm
  output at ONE position (the byproduct's h_a, the lane's registered
  target) rather than their three-layer read (layers 3, L/2, L-2);
  (iv) the training objective is forward KL to the verifier on the
  runs' OWN generated text with the REALISED block structure (their
  synthetic UltraChat/ShareGPT data and their random training offsets
  delta in [1, k] are not reproduced); (v) at a block boundary SD^2's
  inference expands the CURRENT block's guide over the whole fed
  chunk; this freeze's rule (below) puts the PREVIOUS block's delta on
  the earlier row of a 2-token feed so that inference matches the
  training row assignment exactly — a deliberate departure from their
  inference rule, not an oversight.
- INJECTION TIMING, pinned: one delta per block from the anchor the
  block CONSULTS (the prefill read for block 1; the last verified row
  after each verify — the position SD^2 also reads); forward hooks on
  draft.model.layers[l].mlp.up_proj; live for every drafted row of the
  block; cleared before the verify forward. Block-boundary rule: the
  last fed row gets the current block's delta; earlier rows get the
  previous block's delta (zero on the prompt prefill, where no previous
  block exists); a multi-row feed with a previous block set is refused
  (the cached path never does it). Training assigns row t (predicting
  token t+1) to the block that emitted token t+1 — rows start_b-1 ..
  end_b-1 belong to block b, the bonus row of a full-accept block
  included — and the critic traced prefill, 1-token, 2-token-after-
  full-accept and bonus rows to the same assignment. The verifier,
  sideband.specdec, the RNG stream and the byproduct recorder are

  support clip and standardization; h_hat stored float32; (iv) EXPORT

- ADAPTER TRAINING (GPU; python tools/train_inject.py --arm {oracle_h,
  free_inject, tel_inject} --out results/real/oq16_inject_<arm>.pt),
  pinned: data = the four registered runs' blocks — prompt ids re-
  encoded through the runner's encode_prompt with prompt 0's ids sha
  BOUND to each run meta, generated ids from the gen sidecars,
  accepted / anchor_pos / h from the sha-verified byproducts, per-block
  vector = the TRUE h (oracle_h) or the cross-fitted h_hat (arms; sha-
  bound to the export summary); the anchor arithmetic and the emitted-
  token counts are DATA-CONTRACT asserts per prompt (the critic
  recomputed them on all 840 prompt-runs: exact). Roles = the
  registered per-population split: TRAIN + TEST prompts (168/pop)
  train, VAL prompts (42/pop) select the epoch (best VAL KL over
  epochs 1..6, ties -> earlier; a selected adapter worse than the
  untrained no-op is FLAGGED in the meta, never swapped for it — the
  arm then fails the gate on its own). Objective = forward
  KL(p_verifier || q_drafter) per row over the full vocabulary,
  teacher-forced on the runs' own text, the verifier NF4 and frozen,
  the drafter bf16 and frozen, rows = every row carrying a block
  delta; the train loss is the per-prompt mean of row KLs accumulated
  over prompts, the VAL criterion the row-weighted pooled KL —
  identical across the three adapters; TVD REPORTED. AdamW (wd 0), lr
  1e-3 -> 1e-4 cosine with 50 warmup steps, accumulation 8 prompts,
  batch 1, grad-norm clip 1.0, 6 epochs (SD^2's count), seed 0, rank
  512 — judgment-call labels, IDENTICAL across the three adapters
  (the arms differ only in the vector). bf16 kernels are not bit-
  deterministic: the saved weights (sha in the committed <out>.json)
  are the evidence. OOM FALLBACKS pinned now, in order, for ALL three
  adapters alike and disclosed if used: (1) gradient checkpointing on
  the frozen drafter (--grad-checkpoint; the activation term is the
  VRAM driver at L <= 300, not the adapter); (2) rank 256. A --smoke-
  trained adapter is refused by the arm runner.
- GPU LADDER, pinned (each rung launched by the user; nothing chains
  automatically; every run's meta binds the adapter and export shas):
  A0 — ACTUATOR CEILING: export; train oracle_h; run V then O on the
  verdict population at seed 4. Gate: O-vs-V tokens/call (E6; the
  registered paired_ratio_delta_ci, prompt clusters, n_boot 2000,
  seed 0) CI95 lower > 0 AND point >= +0.062 AND the pairwise budget
  guard (O's drafted-per-emitted <= V's + 0.01 — with gamma fixed,
  drafted-per-emitted = 4 / tokens-per-call exactly, so the guard is
  mechanical: more acceptance is a LOWER budget). CLEARS -> A1. FAILS
  -> ACTUATOR-CEILING NULL, a sub-label of the partition's ACTUATOR
  NULL: "not even the TRUE anchor state converts through this frozen-
  drafter rank-512 actuator at this training budget on this box". The

OQ-16 DATED ERRATUM + LANE CLOSURE (2026-09-05, written after the
STAGE-A FREEZE above and before any Stage-A GPU run; evidence
results/real/oq16_ha_identity.json from tools/ha_identity_check.py on
48 pinned rows — the first 4 blocks of the first 3 prompts of each of
the four registered vanilla byproduct runs, sha-bound to their
committed summaries; critic recompute round recorded in F-23):
- THE IDENTITY. The registered Stage-R target is the verifier's
  final-norm output at the anchor, h_a — the input to lm_head.
  Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct's lm_head is an untied, bias-free linear map
  W_U (128256 x 4096; tie_word_embeddings false in the cached config),
  so logits = W_U h_a determines h_a exactly, and the verifier's FULL
  next-token distribution p at the anchor — the quantity D-5 names as
  the mandatory free baseline ("steering from the target's distribution
  at the last verified position, which every speculative decoder
  computes anyway") — determines h_a up to floating-point error.
  Measured: W_U @ h reproduces the logged argmax on 48/48 rows and the
  logged top-32 ids at 0.9948 mean overlap (min 0.969; the logged
  values came from the live bf16 lm_head of the NF4-loaded verifier on
  the float16-logged h; max top-1 probability gap 0.0206); the least-
  squares inverse from the float32 logits recovers h_a with median
  relative error 2.5e-8 (max 3.2e-8), which is the float32 rounding
  floor (from float64 logits: 1.9e-14); closed-form least-squares
  recovery from ONLY the top-k (id, log-prob) pairs of the recomputed
  logits W_U h (not the logged float16 pairs, which contain zeros)
  gives median per-row R^2 +1.0000 at k = 4097, +0.506 at 2048, +0.216
  at 512, +0.078 at 128 and +0.014 at 32 (median cosines 1.000 /
  0.711 / 0.465 / 0.280 / 0.123). METRIC NOTE: that R^2 is 1 - SSE / SS
  about the row's own mean in raw h space and the estimator is a prior-
  free least-squares solve — NOT Stage-R's standardized pooled-MSE R^2
  and NOT comparable to the ridge arms' +0.258 / +0.324. The top-k
  recovery uses log-probabilities only, with the log-partition as an
  extra unknown, so the softmax's additive-constant freedom is
  absorbed: p alone, not the logits, determines h_a. CONDITIONING (the
  one place this could have failed): W_U has full column rank, singular
  values 1.453 .. 94.5 (condition 65); the all-ones vector — the
  softmax's free direction — lies 99.2% inside col(W_U), yet the
  augmented system [W_U, -1] that recovers (h, logZ) from log-
  probabilities has smallest singular value 1.451, so nothing is
  weakly determined; at bfloat16 precision, full log-probabilities with
  logZ unknown recover h_a to median relative error 3.5e-03 (max
  6.9e-03).
- WHAT IT MEANS FOR THE REGISTERED CHAIN. (i) The free-reconstruction
  arm the registration pinned (FREE = probe_input's 657 anchor
  summaries; later FREETOK = ++ hashed top-32 ids, R^2 +0.258;
  FREETOK2 +0.255) was a lossy PROXY for the free information D-5
  names — the full p at the anchor, from which h_a follows exactly
  (R^2 1.000). Every Stage-R and DR readout stands AS PINNED (each
  gate compared the stream against its registered arms and the critic
  recomputed them bit-exact), but their MEANING for the lane
  collapses: the stream's reconstruction of h_a (TEL R^2 +0.253, UNION
  +0.324) is, in K-2's own words, "a lossy copy of information the
  decoder already has" — with no hashing caveat and no DR-5 needed.
  "Beyond p" is now PRICED at this target: nothing is beyond p,
  because p determines the target. (ii) The Stage-A ladder: arms F
  (FREETOK reconstruction) and T (UNION reconstruction) are STRUCK
  pre-GPU — a host that computes p for rejection sampling (every host
  in this repo's harness and every standard speculative decoder) can
  inject h_a itself at the cost of AT MOST one least-squares solve
  against the cached lm_head (a 4096 x 128256 matvec plus a precomputed
  4096 x 4096 inverse; this harness holds h_a directly through its
  final-norm catch, so the solve is the bound for a p-only consumer),
  so injecting a telemetry reconstruction of it has no deployable
  rationale. "Free" is D-5's convention — the steering side holds the
  verifier's distribution; D-1's premise never priced shipping p, the
  top-4097 log-probabilities or h_a itself to a disaggregated drafter,
  which is K-6 territory and is not settled here. Arm O
  (TRUE h_a injection), registered as the NON-DEPLOYABLE ceiling, is
  in fact the DEPLOYABLE free arm — SD^2-lite from the verifier's own
  distribution — and O-vs-V is the free-actuator question, which sits
  OUTSIDE the K-3 kill text and outside this lane's telemetry claim.
  If the user runs it, it runs under its own dated registration (two
  arms, V vs O, seed 4 on data/prompts_oq16_verdict.jsonl, the +0.062
  bar and the budget guard as frozen, label FREE-ACTUATOR WIN / NULL);
  a WIN would be an SD^2 configuration result on this box (frozen
  drafter, rank-512 adapter, single-position final-norm read, gamma 4,
  NF4 verifier), not a sideband result. (iii) What the identity does
  NOT touch, and why. The K-2 existence results (F-15/F-17) concern
  FUTURE-position concepts at offsets 2-3, which the anchor's p does
  not determine. But their free arm (a) is the same 657-summary set
  this erratum calls a lossy proxy for p, so "beyond p?" arises there
  too, and the record's answer is the OQ-6 h-probe row of the same
  grids (results/real/probes_s1{,_replication}.json,
  probes_s3{,_replication}.json, margins_h_vs_a): under the identity a
  LINEAR probe on h_a is a linear probe on the full logit vector (W_U^T
  has full row rank, so the two function classes coincide), i.e. the
  strongest linear free-p baseline — and at the pinned L1 offset-2
  cells it adds nothing over (a): h-a margin S1 +0.0009 [-0.0087,
  +0.0107] primary and -0.0012 [-0.0112, +0.0090] replication, S3
  -0.0026 [-0.0071, +0.0021] and -0.0042 [-0.0093, +0.0015], against
  c-a margins of +0.0163 / +0.0141 (S1) and +0.0147 / +0.0173 (S3); at
  offsets 3-4 the h-probe sits BELOW (a) on all four grids (offset-3
  h-a -0.0205 / -0.0399 / -0.0111 / -0.0173). So the K-2 margins are
  not linear-logit information, and F-15/F-17 stand. What was never
  run: a NONLINEAR-in-p free baseline at the registered mlp256
  capacity (the grids carry (h) at "linear" only). That is the unrun
  K-2 comparator and the one CPU probe-land readout that could still
  touch F-15/F-17; it is not authorized by this erratum. The topic
  controls (F-16/F-18) and the conversion nulls (F-19/F-21) stand on
  their own. The only reconstruction target at which telemetry could
  carry non-free information is h at FUTURE anchors — OQ-16's own
  "anticipatory variant", never run; an existence bound there is
  plausible from F-15/F-17 but unmeasured, and the fold-back-#2 hard
  stop forbids a third arc unless the user authorizes the exception in
  those words.
- CLASSIFICATION: NO partition branch is claimed. The registered
  limbo clause's condition is met (a Stage A never run after a PASS)
  and its rule — "neither limbo may ever be re-labeled a null" — is
  honored: this erratum does not turn the never-run Stage A into a
  null, and the catch-all is NOT invoked, because the branch it would
  name (RECONSTRUCTION-CEILING NULL: "Stage-R leg 1 fails") is
  contradicted by the measured leg-1 pass. The disposition that fits
  the registered text is the partition's own VOID precedent (no branch
  claimed; a dated note records it; the lane stops in practice under
  the fold-back-#2 hard stop). The lane is therefore CLOSED BY DATED
  ERRATUM — TARGET-FREE: the registration's target is free information
  under D-5, so the Stage-A telemetry arms F/T test nothing and are
  struck. STAGE-R PASS stands as the mechanical outcome of its
  registered gate; the DR-3 OUTCOME's sentence "reopens the Stage-A
  telemetry question with a reconstruction-level basis" is SUPERSEDED
  by this erratum. (Critic round, 2026-09-05, before this text was
  committed: an earlier draft of this bullet claimed the catch-all
  "mechanically"; the critic showed that this re-labels a never-run
  stage as a null against the limbo clause's literal text, under a
  branch whose definition the data contradict, and the bullet was
  rewritten before the commit.)
- HOW THIS WAS MISSED, disclosed: the target was chosen for logging
  convenience (model.norm output, one hook) rather than SD^2's mid-
  layer read (layers 3, L/2, L-2), which no identity of this kind ties
  to p (the map from a mid-layer state to p is many-to-one; how much of
  those states p predicts is unmeasured);
  the free arm was assembled from the existing probe_input summaries
  rather than from D-5's definition; the DR-2/DR-3/DR-4 chain then
  priced "beyond FREETOK's encoding" with increasingly clever hashes
  while the closed-form free comparator (p -> h_a exactly) was one
  linear solve away. The observation came from a creative-lens
  adversarial pass over the gathered data (2026-09-05, contrarian

  scratch check, and by the committed tool; the critic recompute round

- WHAT THE PRE-GPU STAGE-A INSTRUMENT IS NOW: the injection adapter,

  the critic from the committed payloads): (i) (a) = 657 logged
  summaries of p_a (bucket masses in four spaces, entropy, top-32

  `hidden` array, the final-norm state that produced p_a — is an exact
  linear function of the FULL p_a, free under D-5. (iv) The registered
  (h) arm exists at LINEAR capacity and L1 only. Its margin over (a):
  off2 +0.0009 / -0.0012 (S1 primary / replication), -0.0026 / -0.0042
  (S3); off3 -0.0205 / -0.0399 (S1), -0.0111 / -0.0173 (S3); off4

  the (h) linear cells sit at or below the floor on 6 of the 8 harvest
  x offset-2/3 cells (per seed, acc minus the unshuffled floor: the two
  S1 off2 cells are above it, +0.0176 / +0.0121 / +0.0166 primary and

  -0.0444, S3 -0.0075 / -0.0089 / -0.0120, S3 replication -0.0116 /

  F-15/F-17 — "(h) adds nothing over (a) at the pinned cells" — is a

- ARMS (feature labels in cell ids; block ORDER identical across arms,
  so the seeded init tensor lands on the same feature positions —
  verified by a CI test on the factories):
  fplus   = (a) ++ TOK ++ hz. TOK = multi-hot of the anchor's top-32
            next-token ids hashed id mod 2048 (sideband.recon.
            FREETOK_BINS; the per-anchor form is asserted equal to
            sideband.recon.tok_block by a CI test; on S3 this is the
            SAME RULE as DR-2 over OLMoE's ~50k vocabulary, about 25

            encoding"). hz = h_a STANDARDIZED (see TRAINER): the
            harvest `hidden` array, 4096 dims on S1, 2048 on S3;
  fplus_b = fplus ++ (b), the aligned telemetry multi-hot (4 x 512 =
            2048 on S1; 16 x 64 = 1024 on S3);
  fplus_n = fplus ++ ALIGNMENT-DESTROYED telemetry — the slot vector of
            anchor (a + 17) mod row-length (the P1 SLOT_SHIFT; R2's
            shift trick on features). The "rows shorter than 18"
            sliver is EMPTY on all four harvests (minimum generated
            length 30 / 112 / 31 / 69 for S1 primary / S1 replication /
            S3 primary / S3 replication, read from the harvest npz
            lengths on 2026-09-06), so the destruction is clean. Equal
            dims to fplus_b by construction (the instrument refuses
            otherwise). Expected totals, recorded in each payload from
            the loaded arrays and never asserted: 657 + 2048 + 4096 (+
            2048) on S1 = 6801 / 8849; 657 + 2048 + 2048 (+ 1024) on S3
            = 4753 / 5777.
- TRAINER. The registered Phase-3 trainer with its optimizer and
  budget byte-identical (30 epochs, batch 4096, AdamW lr 3e-3,
  VAL-selected epoch, TEST read once) and ONE pre-scaling, pinned
  here before any registered cell: h_a enters every arm as hz =
  (clip(h_a, lo_c, hi_c) - mu_c) / max(sd_c, 1e-6) per channel c,
  where lo/hi/mu/sd are computed once per harvest, in float64, over
  EVERY valid position of EVERY train-split row of the loaded harvest
  (the same prompt split the probes use; VAL and TEST rows never
  contribute), cast to float32, and hashed into the payload's
  provenance (standardization.moments_sha256) — the F-22 DR-1 support-
  clip lesson applied to the one raw-valued block. Every other block
  is unchanged; all three arms get the same hz, so D is unaffected by
  construction. Why pinned now rather than "byte-identical": the
  committed (h) record in (iv) and the scratch smoke disclosed at the
  end of this block show the raw trainer cannot hold the constant
  predictor on an h_a-bearing arm, which would make D a comparison of
  two thrashing probes and the shuffle rider's relative band noise.
  READER SCOPE, symmetric: every label is a statement about the
  registered reader at the registered budget — a SURVIVES verdict is
  licensed only as "survives the registered reader", an ABSORBED
  verdict only as "absorbed at the registered reader" — because mlp256
  for 30 epochs on hz is one reader of p_a, not the best one, and a
  stronger reader remains a named residual under BOTH labels (an
  earlier draft scoped SURVIVES only and gave ABSORBED an unscoped
  K-2 kill; corrected in the second critic round). EPOCH SELECTION,
  disclosed from the second smoke: every fplus cell selected
  best_epoch 0 (the first of the 30 epochs is the best VAL epoch at
  6801 dims), where the committed S1 primary off2 mlp256 cells
  selected epochs 15 / 24 / 9 for (a), 3 / 2 / 3 for (b) and 5 / 2 / 6
  for (c) (probes_s1.json cells). The registered rule — VAL selection
  at epoch granularity, ties to the earlier epoch — is honored as
  written; the effective reader on the h_a-bearing arms is one pass of
  AdamW; both twins share the seeded init and batch order, so this
  cannot favour SURVIVES, and it can only push D toward zero. The
  payload reports best_epoch per cell and a best_epochs summary under
  reader_valid (reported, never gating).
- READER-VALIDITY PRECONDITION (pinned; mechanical in the tool). Per
  harvest, at the gate cell L1 / off2 / mlp256: every one of the 9
  unshuffled probes (3 arms x 3 seeds) must have test_acc >=
  majority_rate_test - 0.001, AND the Mf row at that cell must have
  CI95 upper >= 0 (the full free baseline may not be CI-clear worse
  than its own 657-dim subset). Otherwise the harvest is READER-
  INVALID: no SURVIVES / ABSORBED / NOT-SHOWN / SPLIT may issue from
  it, the payload records reader_valid.ok = false, --conclude-from
  returns READER-INVALID for the source, and the registered path is a
  DATED amendment of the reader (standardization of the other blocks,
  budget, or learning rate) before any further cell — never a same-
  trainer rerun and never a label read through the invalid reader.
- CELLS. Per harvest: L1 x off2 x {linear, mlp256} x train seeds
  {0,1,2} x 3 arms = 18; S1 adds L1 x off3 x mlp256 x 3 seeds x 3 arms
  = 9 (F-15's demonstrated horizon is offsets 2-3; F-17's L1 horizon is
  offset 2 only, so S3 runs off2 only; the offsets are BOUND to the
  source tag in the tool — "concept" -> {2,3}, "olmoe" -> {2} — and
  --conclude-from refuses a payload whose offsets are not its source's).
  LEAK RIDER on the new arm pair (shuffled fplus and shuffled fplus_b at
  L1/off2/linear/seed 0, run FIRST, fresh or resumed alike): leg 1,
  shuffled fplus <= the COMMITTED Phase-3 shuffled (a) cell of the same
  harvest (L1|off2|a|linear|s0|SHUFFLED, read from the sha-bound state
  file: 0.58889 / 0.58714 / 0.57992 / 0.58581 for S1 primary / S1
  replication / S3 primary / S3 replication) + 0.01 — a (row, anchor)
  leak in the blocks SHARED by all three arms (TOK, hz) shows here and
  nowhere else; leg 2, shuffled fplus_b <= shuffled fplus + 0.01 — a
  leak in the slots block. Either failure halts the grid. DISCLOSED:
  the committed shuffled (a) sits exactly on its floor while the
  6801-dim epoch-0 shuffled fplus sat about 1.5 points below it in the
  second smoke, so leg 1's effective detection threshold is about
  0.026 above the observed level rather than 0.01; the CI anchor-
  coordinate test on the block classes is the primary guard for the
  shared blocks, and the band is not tightened post hoc. (An earlier
  draft had leg 2 only, which is blind to a shared-block leak that
  would inflate all three arms toward saturation and push D to zero —
  an ABSORBED-faking path; corrected on critic review before any
  registered cell ran.) Both harvests per source: S1 primary
  (generation seeds 0-7) and replication (8-11); S3 primary and
  replication. 90 trained cells + 8 shuffled in all. Estimand,
  bootstrap and pairing as Phase 3 (per-prompt successes summed over
  the three train seeds; paired_cluster_delta_ci, n_boot 2000, seed 0;
  exactly 30 test clusters or the pairing is refused). New cells are
  paired against the COMMITTED Phase-3 state files' (a) and (c)
  cluster counts for Mf / Mc (same harvest, split and anchors; trials
  must match or the pairing aborts; the state files are read through
  their sha bindings and must reproduce their own payload margins to
  1e-12 at load or the run aborts).
- READOUTS (pinned): D = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus_n), equal dims, THE
  gate readout; Mt = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus), dims-asymmetric,
  quoted beside D in every statement of the result; Mn = acc(fplus_n)
  - acc(fplus), the pure dilution estimate, descriptive; Mf =
  acc(fplus) - acc(a), how much the full free baseline adds over the
  registered proxy, reported and part of the precondition; Mc =
  acc(fplus) - acc(c), the full free baseline against the committed
  telemetry arm, reported.
- GATE AND LABELS (pinned). The gate cell per harvest is L1 / off2 /
  mlp256, readout D, the Phase-3 triple rule: CI95 lower > 0, all three
  train seeds positive, point >= +0.005 (the row must carry n_seeds 3,
  n_clusters 30 and the fplus_b-fplus_n pairing, or it does not fire).
  Per SOURCE, from both harvests (tools/run_fullfree.py --conclude-from
  PRIMARY REPLICATION, mechanical; it refuses a partial payload, a
  failed rider, a payload whose harvest is not the registered primary /
  replication directory for its source, or a same-harvest pair):
  READER-INVALID if either harvest fails the precondition;
  SURVIVES-FULL-FREE iff the gate fires on both harvests;
  SPLIT iff it fires on exactly one;
  ABSORBED iff it fires on neither AND every D row of both harvests
    (the gate row, the linear off2 row and, on S1, the off3 row) has
    CI95 upper < +0.005 — the strong null, in the form P1's DEFLATES
    gate used (all uppers below the floor), never from a straddle;
  NOT-SHOWN iff it fires on neither but some D row's CI95 upper is >=
    +0.005 — the test could not re-demonstrate the margin at this
    power, and could not exclude it;
  INCOMPLETE if a gate row is missing (no verdict).
  The linear off2 cells are REPORTED. HORIZON rule (S1, reported): off3
  D at mlp256 — both harvests fire = OFF3-SURVIVES; both fail AND both
  off3 CI95 uppers < +0.005 = OFF3-ABSORBED; both fail otherwise =
  OFF3-NOT-SHOWN (a straddle never narrows the horizon; an earlier
  draft let it, corrected in the second critic round); one missing =
  OFF3-INCOMPLETE; else OFF3-SPLIT.
  Multiplicity: four gate cells in all (two sources x two harvests),
  one readout each, no correction; everything else reported. Which
  harvest is "primary" is fixed by the registered directory names and
  the labels are symmetric in the two, so the choice cannot be gamed.
- LICENSED SENTENCES (pinned). Any SURVIVES statement quotes Mt beside
  D. If Mt's CI95 upper is >= 0 at the gate cell on both harvests, the
  licensed sentence is "aligned telemetry carries future-concept
  information beyond the full free baseline at the registered reader",
  and the token-identity residual (docs/IDEAS.md rank 4, an Mt-type [withheld: docs/IDEAS.md not in this repository; see WITHHELD.md]
  readout) and the nonlinear-in-p residual (F-23) close for that
  source at the registered reader. If Mt's CI95 upper is < 0 on either
  harvest, the licensed sentence is only "aligned telemetry carries
  information beyond the full free baseline at equal dims (D); at this
  budget adding it did not raise accuracy (Mt)", and NEITHER residual
  is said to close (the payload's survives_license field says which).

            at every registered offset) and records the wrap fraction
            per seed and offset (recomputed on critic review from the
            harvest npz: 0.95-0.99% S1 primary, 0.59-0.64% S1
            replication, 3.37-3.56% S3 primary, 2.99-3.23% S3
            replication, flat across offsets 2-4; same-prompt 0.0 on
            all 48 (harvest, seed, offset) cells). Equal dims to
            fplus_b by construction (refused otherwise); expected
            totals as OQ-17 (S1 6801 / 8849; S3 4753 / 5777),
            recorded, never asserted.
  a       = the registered 657-summary arm, run FRESH at mlp256 (three
            seeds, off2) through the registered Phase-3 call (no extra
            factory, no relabel — the call that produced the committed
            L1 mlp256 (a) cells), because Phase 3 holds no mlp256 cell
            at L2 / L3 and the precondition and Mf must read at the
            gate capacity. The COMMITTED linear (a) and (c) cells of
            the same harvest are paired for Mf / Mc at linear and for
            the precondition's third leg through the sha-bound state
            files (they must reproduce their own payload margins to
            1e-12 at load, as in OQ-17); before anything trains the
            tool refuses a grid whose cell ids collide with any
            committed cell (no committed cell is ever re-trained or
            overwritten; Phase 3 has no mlp256 or shuffled cell at L2 /
            L3, so the collision set is empty) and refuses a missing
            committed linear (a) or (c) cell at any registered (space,
            offset, seed).
- TRAINER. Byte-identical to OQ-17: the registered Phase-3 trainer,
  optimizer and budget (30 epochs, batch 4096, AdamW lr 3e-3, VAL-
  selected epoch, TEST read once) with the one OQ-17 pre-scaling of
  h_a (clip to the TRAIN support, z-score with TRAIN moments computed
  once per harvest over every valid position of every train-split
  row; the moments sha is recorded in standardization.moments_sha256
  and asserted equal to the committed OQ-17 payload's, see ARMS).
  READER SCOPE, symmetric as in OQ-17: every label is a statement
  about the registered reader at the registered budget; a stronger or
  differently balanced reader is a named residual under SURVIVES and
  ABSORBED alike (F-24 disclosed that the h_a-bearing arms select
  epochs 0-2 and that the dense hz block dominates the input norm).
  The 511-class L2 head (mlp256 hidden to 511 outputs) is larger than
  the 16-class L1 head the OQ-17 numbers describe; nothing here
  changes the trainer for it. The payload reports best_epoch per cell
  and a best_epochs summary per space under reader_valid (reported,
  never gating).
- READER-VALIDITY PRECONDITION (pinned; mechanical in the tool), per
  (harvest, space), at the space's gate cell off2 / mlp256, THREE legs:
  (1) every one of the 12 unshuffled probes (3 arms + (a), 3 seeds)
  has test_acc >= majority_rate_test - 0.001; (2) the Mf row at that
  cell (fplus minus the FRESH (a)) has CI95 upper >= 0; (3) the Mf_x
  row at that cell — fplus at mlp256 paired, on the same rows, anchors
  and trials, against the COMMITTED LINEAR (a) cells of the same
  (space, offset, seed), read through copies relabeled "a_lin" at the
  gate capacity so the registered margins() pairing applies unchanged
  — has CI95 upper >= 0. Leg 3 exists because legs 1-2 cannot see a
  reader COLLAPSED to the constant predictor (pre-run critic round,
  B2): twelve probes exactly at their floor pass leg 1, and identical
  successes give Mf = 0 [0, 0] and pass leg 2, so a collapsed reader
  would read D = 0 [0, 0] and land ABSORBED through a reader that
  reads nothing; against the committed linear (a) such a reader loses
  by the proxy's own read over the floor (WHY (v): about -0.010 at S1
  L2, -0.057 / -0.087 at L3 S1 / S3), CI-clear, and leg 3 refuses it.
  The leg involves no telemetry arm, so it can suppress a false kill
  or a "telemetry rescues a collapsed reader" false SURVIVES alike and
  can manufacture neither. Its limit is disclosed: at S3 L2 the proxy
  reads only +0.0017..+0.0024 over the floor, so a collapsed reader
  loses by that little there, and the payload therefore reports
  acc(fplus, mlp256) - floor per seed beside every label (a null at
  S3 L2 is quoted with that read). Otherwise that (harvest, space) is
  READER-INVALID: no label may issue for the space, the payload
  records reader_valid.ok = false there, --conclude-from returns
  READER-INVALID for that (source, space), and the registered path is
  a DATED amendment of the reader before any further cell at that
  space — never a same-trainer rerun and never a label read through
  the invalid reader. The (a) probes are inside leg 1 so a collapsed
  (a) cannot make Mf pass by default.
- CELLS. Per harvest, space by space (L2 then L3), in this order:
  the LEAK RIDER — shuffled (a), shuffled fplus and shuffled fplus_b at
  off2 / linear / seed 0 (3 cells) — then fresh (a) x mlp256 x off2 x
  3 seeds (3), then off2 x {linear, mlp256} x 3 seeds x 3 arms (18),
  then each FURTHER registered offset x mlp256 x 3 seeds x 3 arms (9
  each). Offsets are BOUND per space to the F-15 / F-17 firing sets
  that fired on BOTH harvests (the table above): S1 L2 {2,3}, S1 L3
  {2,3}, S3 L2 {2,3}, S3 L3 {2,3,4}; --conclude-from refuses a payload
  whose offsets differ. Totals per harvest: S1 33 + 33 = 66 cells (60
  trained + 6 shuffled); S3 33 + 42 = 75 (69 + 6); four harvests, 258
  trained cells + 24 shuffled in all. LEAK RIDER, DEVIATION FROM OQ-17
  PINNED HERE: OQ-17's leg 1 compared shuffled fplus against the
  COMMITTED Phase-3 shuffled (a) cell; Phase 3 shuffled L1 only, so at
  L2 / L3 the reference is a FRESH shuffled (a) cell of the same space
  trained in this run through the registered Phase-3 shuffle call
  (label shift on the same rows and anchors). Leg 1: shuffled fplus <=
  fresh shuffled (a) + 0.01 (a (row, anchor) leak in the blocks shared
  by all three arms — TOK, hz — shows here); leg 2: shuffled fplus_b
  <= shuffled fplus + 0.01 (a leak in the slots block). A failed leg
  HALTS THE RUN before any payload is written, fresh or resumed cells
  alike: that harvest then has no payload, BOTH its spaces are label-
  less, and since a (source, space) label needs both harvests the
  whole SOURCE goes label-less until the leak is diagnosed and a dated
  amendment made — no partial label is read around a failed rider.
  The OQ-17 disclosures carry over: a high-dimensional epoch-0 shuffled
  fplus can sit below the shuffled (a) floor, so leg 1's effective
  detection threshold may be wider than 0.01 (the smokes below show
  it), and leg 2's band of 0.01 is twice the +0.005 materiality floor;
  the CI anchor-coordinate tests on the block classes remain the
  primary guard for the shared blocks and neither band is tightened
  post hoc. INDEX-MISALIGNMENT COVERAGE: the circular-shift rider
  cannot see a misaligned feature index (F-15 (iii)), and this test
  runs no offset-1 control; that coverage is inherited from Phase 3's
  sha-bound arrays (the same (row, anchor) coordinates, read through
  the same block classes) and from the CI coordinate tests — stated,
  not re-tested. Both harvests per source: S1 primary (generation
  seeds 0-7) and replication (8-11); S3 primary and replication.
  Estimand, bootstrap and pairing as Phase 3 / OQ-17 (per-prompt
  successes summed over the three train seeds; paired_cluster_delta_ci,
  n_boot 2000, seed 0; exactly 30 test clusters or the pairing is
  refused).
- READOUTS (pinned), per space: D = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus_r), equal
  dims, THE gate readout; Mt = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus), dims-
  asymmetric, quoted beside D in every statement of the result; Mn_r =
  acc(fplus_r) - acc(fplus), the corrected twin's own gain,
  descriptive; Mf = acc(fplus) - acc(a) at mlp256 (fresh (a)) and
  linear (committed (a)), reported and part of the precondition; Mf_x
  = acc(fplus, mlp256) - acc(committed (a), linear), the precondition's
  third leg, reported; Mc = acc(fplus) - acc(c) at linear against the
  committed telemetry arm, reported.
- GATE AND LABELS (pinned). The gate cell per (harvest, space) is off2
  / mlp256, readout D, the Phase-3 triple rule: CI95 lower > 0, all
  three train seeds positive, point >= +0.005 (the row must carry
  n_seeds 3, n_clusters 30 and the fplus_b-fplus_r pairing, or it does
  not fire; --conclude-from refuses a payload in which ANY D row —
  gate, linear or further-offset — lacks those three structural
  properties, since the further-offset and linear rows decide ABSORBED
  and the horizons). Per (SOURCE, SPACE), from both harvests (tools/
  run_fullfree_coarse.py --conclude-from PRIMARY REPLICATION,
  mechanical; it refuses a partial payload, a failed rider at any
  space, a payload whose harvest is not the registered primary /
  replication directory for its source, a payload written to any but
  the registered out name, unregistered levels / offsets, a missing or
  structurally thin D row, or a same-harvest pair): READER-INVALID if
  either harvest fails the precondition at that space; SURVIVES-FULL-
  FREE iff the gate fires on both harvests; SPLIT iff on exactly one;
  ABSORBED iff on neither AND every D row of both harvests at that
  space (the gate row, the linear off2 row and every further-offset
  row) has CI95 upper < +0.005; NOT-SHOWN iff on neither but some D
  row's upper is >= +0.005. INCOMPLETE is the label of a payload-less
  source (a halted rider, an unfinished run); it cannot issue from
  --conclude-from, which refuses such payloads outright. The linear
  off2 rows are REPORTED (they are the capacity at which F-15 / F-17
  fired at L2 / L3). HORIZON rule at each further offset (mlp256,
  reported): both harvests fire = OFFk-SURVIVES; both fail AND both
  uppers < +0.005 = OFFk-ABSORBED; both fail otherwise = OFFk-NOT-
  SHOWN (a straddle never narrows the horizon; an upper exactly at
  +0.005 is not below it); one missing = OFFk-INCOMPLETE; else OFFk-
  SPLIT (k = 3, and 4 on S3 L3). MULTIPLICITY: EIGHT gate cells (two
  sources x two spaces x two harvests) = four label-level double-fire
  opportunities, plus five horizon double-fire opportunities (OFF3 at
  all four (source, space) pairs, OFF4 at S3 L3), one readout each, no
  correction, the per-(source, space) label needing both harvests as
  the insurance; the ABSORBED / NOT-SHOWN split conditions on 12 (S1)
  / 14 (S3) D-row uppers per source, and more rows push toward
  NOT-SHOWN under a null, which is the conservative direction;
  everything else reported. Which harvest is "primary" is fixed by the
  registered directory names and the labels are symmetric in the two.
- LICENSED SENTENCES (pinned). Any SURVIVES statement quotes Mt AND
  Mn_r beside D and names the reader. The license is FULL — "aligned
  telemetry carries coarse future-concept information at L_k beyond
  the full free baseline at the registered reader" — only if BOTH Mt's
  and Mn_r's CI95 uppers are >= 0 at the gate cell on both harvests
  (pre-run critic round, B3: by the paired identity D = Mt - Mn_r, a
  gate fire on a harvest where the corrected twin is CI-clear HARMFUL
  is bought by the twin's cost, so a fire with Mn_r's upper < 0 is
  written "at equal dims (D), inflated by up to |Mn_r| by the twin's
  own cost"; a fire with Mt's upper < 0 is written "at equal dims (D);
  at this budget adding it did not raise accuracy (Mt)"; the payload's
  survives_license and license_reason say which). HELPS-DIRECTION
  READINGS, pinned now because at coarse labels Mt can be MATERIAL
  where F-24's was not (Phase-3 (b)-(a) at L3 linear is +0.034 at S3
  and +0.016 at S1 per seed): if Mt fires the triple rule at the gate
  cell but D does not, the sentence is F-24's — "the aligned block's
  gain over the full free baseline is matched by a prompt-independent
  same-marginal block" — and no existence sentence issues; if Mn_r
  itself fires the triple rule on a harvest, the corrected twin is
  "not accuracy-inert at this space" and any ABSORBED erratum at that
  (source, space) says so beside its numbers (the payload records
  mt_fires_triple_rule and mn_r_fires_triple_rule per harvest). Every
  L3 sentence, in either direction, carries the lens qualifier "at the
  L3 group lens (S1: one mega-group of 455/510 concepts including all
  165 zero-degree concepts, the next group 10; S3: two mega-groups of
  268 and 193 = 461/510 including all 20 zero-degree concepts)". No
  sentence here touches conversion (K-3's two nulls stand regardless),
  the L1 verdict (F-24 stands as written) or wall-clock.
- CONSEQUENCE RULES (pinned), per (source, space), F-15 for S1 and
  F-17 for S3:
  * SURVIVES-FULL-FREE: the finding gets a dated STATUS line — "at L_k

  * NOT-SHOWN: a dated erratum on the wording only ("beyond the 657-

  * HORIZONS: OFFk-ABSORBED with SURVIVES at off2 — a dated note on the

before the freeze commit and recorded at the end of this block; the
registered runs launch only after that commit):

  docs/FUTURE_IDEAS.md P1 and docs/IDEAS.md, TO VERIFY before any [withheld: docs/FUTURE_IDEAS.md, docs/IDEAS.md not in this repository; see WITHHELD.md]

  THIS model under THIS harness with the record's own controls, not

  product pitch ("real signal, ST-MoE owns the cell") stands and is

  DATED NOTE 2026-10-16 (the operator's call of 2026-10-16, re-deciding PC-2

  public cut and its name is marked there; the commercial framing of that idea

- DATA. The committed S3 harvests, opened only through
  sideband.harvest.verified_seed_files (sha-bound; a mismatch refuses):
  PRIMARY = results/real/harvest_moe, shards moe_s0..moe_s7 (8
  generation seeds; the P1 entry's "moe_s{0..4}" and OQ-19's "5 x 210"
  were wrong — dated correction in docs/FUTURE_IDEAS.md this date); [withheld: docs/FUTURE_IDEAS.md not in this repository; see WITHHELD.md]
  REPLICATION = results/real/harvest_moe_r, moe_s8..moe_s11. Per row
  and position the npz key "slots" (rows, 256, 16, 8) int16 holds the
  sorted top-8 expert ids at the 16 router gates (set semantics, -1
  beyond a row's length), "tokens" the emitted ids, "lengths",
  "prompt_idx"; readout (iv) also reads "mass16", "mass64", "entropy"
  and the committed L1 label space (results/real/buckets_olmoe_k16.json
  + glue_olmoe_k16.json through sideband.probes.load_label_space: glue
  and unbucketed merged into class C exactly as Phase 3). Split: the
  pinned prompt rule (prompt_idx % 7: {0..4} train, 5 val, 6 test —
  150 / 30 / 30 prompts). Readers FIT on train rows pooled over seeds,
  lambda SELECTED on val, every reported number READ on the 30 TEST
  prompts pooled over seeds and positions. The primary harvest is the
  VERDICT harvest; the replication is CONFIRMATORY (disclosure 1).
- NOTATION. E = 64 experts, L = 16 gates, K = 8 experts per gate per
  token; S[t, l] the set at position t, gate l. A RESIDENT set of
  budget B is any B expert ids at one gate. HIT RATE at budget B = the
  number of a target set's eight experts inside the resident set,
  summed over positions, divided by 8 times the positions — a COUNT,
  never bytes or latency (K-5 / K-6 stay unpriced here). Budgets B in
  {8, 16, 32}; B = 16 is the LABEL budget (the budget of the disclosed
  unregistered check); 8 and 32 are reported.
- READOUTS. Every arm of a readout is evaluated on IDENTICAL positions,
  so per-prompt trials are equal across arms and sideband.stats.
  paired_cluster_delta_ci applies; single-arm CIs by sideband.stats.
  cluster_bootstrap_ci; n_boot 2000, boot seed 0, 30 test-prompt
  clusters; rows sorted canonically before every bootstrap.
  (i)   CROSS-TOKEN REUSE (policy, no fitting). Per gate l, horizon j in
        {1,2,3,4}: RECENCY_B(t) = the B most recently used distinct
        experts at gate l up to and including position t (last-use
        position descending; all eight of one position enter together;
        the tie among one position's experts breaks by expert id
        ascending — it matters only when B is not a multiple of 8, which
        no registered B is). At B = 8 the resident set IS S[t, l]
        (self-reuse). Estimand: hit rate of S[t+j, l] against
        RECENCY_B(t). Positions: t with t + j < row length.
  INDEX CONVENTION for every token arm (sideband.harvest, block-start
        alignment): forward t has INPUT tokens[t-1], OUTPUT p_t and
        routing S[t]; tokens[t] is sampled from p_t. At anchor t the
        decoder holds S[t] and tokens[t] — the bonus token, FREE — so
        S[t+1] is the routing of the forward tokens[t] feeds, and S[t+2]
        the routing of the forward the draft's FIRST proposal feeds
        (stand-in: the true tokens[t+1], the D-2 ceiling draft). TABLE =
        the train conditional expert frequencies of the forward a token
        feeds: counts over train positions t of S[t+1] keyed on
        tokens[t], normalised per gate; a token with no train count at a
        gate takes MARGINAL's frequencies at the j = 1 target positions.
        TABLE(x) is a 1024-dim vector: the token's own train routing
        profile, without hash collisions, at the capacity of one
        multi-hot (chosen over the FREETOK hash, which loses identity at
        about 25 ids per bin, so that the free arm is the strongest cheap
        token encoding — the F-24 lesson). TABLE is train-fit, so at a
        ridge's TRAIN rows it is read LEAVE-ONE-PROMPT-OUT: every
        contribution of the row's own PROMPT under that key — all its
        seeds, all its positions, which include the row's own (t -> t+1)
        and, at j = 2, (t+1 -> t+2) entries — is subtracted from the
        counts before normalising (a (prompt, token) pair table built
        from the same positions; a gate whose count reaches zero takes
        the marginal); this is the TEST information set exactly, since
        test prompts are disjoint from train (critic's second pass: an
        in-sample table at a singleton key IS the target; third pass:
        a position-only leave-one-out still left the same prompt's
        other contributions in the train feature, and a leave-one-row-
        out variant on the smoke moved ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN by -0.008
        with the primary's eight seeds per prompt making the residual
        larger — both would bias HISTORY_TOK and DRAFT_FULL downward at
        test relative to FREE_TOK). Val and test rows read the full
        train table. The marginal fallback itself keeps every prompt's
        counts (negligible at 300k positions; disclosed). The
        share of positions whose key token has no train count (the
        marginal fallback) and the train singleton-key share are
        recorded in the payload per split.
  (i-b) LEARNED ARMS PER HORIZON j (closed-form ridge W = (X'X +
        lambda I)^-1 X'Y in float64, every coordinate incl. the bias
        regularised alike; ONE train Gram per horizon over the full
        design [S[t] multi-hot (1024, sideband.probes.slots_multi_hot)
        ++ TABLE(tokens[t]) ++ (j = 2 only) TABLE(tokens[t+1]) ++ bias],
        every arm a slice of it, so all arms of a horizon share
        positions exactly; the resident set at gate l = the B largest
        predicted scores among that gate's 64 coordinates, ties by
        expert id ascending, stable sort):
        HISTORY     = S[t] ++ bias — ADDRESS-ONLY (j = 1..4).
        FREE_TOK    = TABLE(tokens[t]) ++ bias — the FREE input-token
                      arm, D-5's analogue for prefetch (j = 1..4).
        HISTORY_TOK = S[t] ++ TABLE(tokens[t]) ++ bias — the addresses
                      OVER the free token (j = 1..4).
        FREE_TABLE  = zero-fit: top-B of TABLE(tokens[t]) (j = 1).
        Baselines at the same B and j: RECENCY_B (i) and MARGINAL_B =
        the B most frequent experts at gate l among the TARGET positions
        of train rows.
  (ii)  INTRA-FORWARD PREFETCH (learned; the timing cell). Lead k in
        {1,2,4}; for target gate l >= k the features are the multi-hot
        of gates 0..l-k of the SAME position ++ bias (one train Gram
        over the full 1024-dim multi-hot, sliced per (l, k)); target
        S[t, l]; one lambda per lead selected on val at B = 16 pooled
        over target gates. Baseline: MARGINAL_B at gate l over all
        train positions. (i) at j = 1 is reported beside it as the
        cross-token reference. Positions: every valid position t.
  (iii) DRAFT-CONDITIONED PREFETCH, horizon j = 2 only — the forward the
        draft's first proposal feeds. The "draft" is the true
        tokens[t+1], a PERFECT draft, the D-2-named non-causal ceiling of
        what any real drafter could supply; no draft model is paired
        with OLMoE in the harness. DRAFT_FREE = TABLE(tokens[t]) ++
        TABLE(tokens[t+1]) ++ bias (both tokens, no addresses);
        DRAFT_FULL = S[t] ++ TABLE(tokens[t]) ++ TABLE(tokens[t+1]) ++
        bias. Baselines: HISTORY_TOK and FREE_TOK at j = 2 (the same
        readers without the draft token) and RECENCY_B.
  (iv)  FRONT-LOADING CURVE (REPORTED ONLY; no label, no consequence;
        included on the user's interest in the timing edge). Offsets o
        in {1, 2}; anchors a >= 1 whose offset label is in range; label
        = the merged-glue L1 class of tokens[label_index(a, o)]. Arms:
        GATES<=l for l in 1..16 = ridge to one-hot on the multi-hot of
        gates 0..l-1 ++ bias, argmax; FREE_PREV = ridge on [mass16[a-1]
        (16) ++ mass64[a-1] (64) ++ entropy[a-1] (1), each z-scored with
        TRAIN moments (sd set to 1 where the train sd is exactly zero), ++ one-hot L1 class of tokens[a-1] ++
        bias] — the previous position's distribution summaries and the
        token it emitted, what the decoder holds while the anchor's
        forward is still running; FLOOR = the train majority class. The
        outcome text reports FREE_PREV minus FLOOR and names the floor
        class and its rate. Estimand: top-1 accuracy; delta GATES<=l minus
        FREE_PREV paired per prompt. One lambda per arm family selected
        on val at offset 1 pooled over depths. It licenses NOTHING about
        "beyond free": the anchor's full routing IS the forward that
        produces p_a, so GATES<=16 beating FREE_PREV at offset 1 is
        expected and says only WHEN in the forward the information
        appears.
- LAMBDA. Grid {0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000}; selection on the val split by
  the readout's own estimand at B = 16 (accuracy at offset 1 for (iv)),
  ties to the smaller lambda; the chosen lambda and a grid-edge flag
  per family are recorded in the payload (the F-19..F-22 grid-edge
  duty).
- EVIDENCE. results/real/prefetch_s3.json and prefetch_s3_r.json with
  .meta.json and .state.jsonl (one row per (arm, budget, key, depth,
  gate, test prompt): hits, needed — the recompute surface; committed,
  .gitignore negated). --conclude-from recomputes every point, CI,
  delta and label from the state file and refuses a payload whose
  stored numbers differ. Instrument tools/run_prefetch_readouts.py
  (numpy only; nothing imports torch); tests tests/test_prefetch_
  readouts.py (synthetic harvests with known rules; a fake sha-bound
  harvest directory and label space exercise the full CLI path).
  --conclude-from is the EXACT recompute surface (integer counts, a
  seeded percentile bootstrap); a clean-worktree rerun of the
  instrument is expected to reproduce the state file to the integer but
  is not guaranteed bit-exact under a different BLAS configuration
  (float64 Gram summation order can move a near-tied top-B boundary),
  and the outcome text says so.
- LABELS (mechanical, from the PRIMARY harvest's TEST rows at B = 16,
  pooled over gates; the replication's labels are computed identically
  and reported as "replication agrees / disagrees" — the registered
  label is the primary's):
  CACHE-SUFFICIENT: RECENCY_16 at j = 1 pooled point >= 0.90 — the
    trivial policy already covers the next set; a predictor has no
    headroom on this model and the stage closes (P1's first kill, with
    the budget it lacked pinned). B = 32 is P1's own window (the union
    of the last four sets holds up to 32 experts): RECENCY_32 at j = 1
    is reported with a would-fire flag, and if it is >= 0.90 the outcome
    text states that the P1-window kill would have fired at its own
    budget.
  Otherwise four per-readout READINGS, each SIGNAL (paired delta CI95
  lower > 0 AND point >= +0.05 hit rate — the materiality floor, a
  pinned convention not derived from a cost model, disclosed as F-13's
  0.5 gate bar was), NOT-SHOWN (CI95 includes zero, or CI-positive
  below the floor), or NEGATIVE (CI95 upper < 0):
  HISTORY: HISTORY minus RECENCY_16 at j = 1 — an address-only learned
    reader against the cache policy (the prior-art cell).
  ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN: HISTORY_TOK minus FREE_TOK at j = 1 — what the
    address stream adds over the FREE input token at matched capacity;
    the D-5 analogue, and the only reading that speaks to the sideband
    premise. HISTORY_TOK minus HISTORY, FREE_TOK minus RECENCY_16 and
    FREE_TABLE minus RECENCY_16 are reported beside it.
  INTRA-FORWARD: (ii) lead 1 minus MARGINAL_16, pooled over target
    gates 1..15 (P1's second kill is INTRA-FORWARD NOT-SHOWN or
    NEGATIVE: intra-forward prefetch has no demonstrated signal on this
    model at this reader).
  DRAFT: DRAFT_FULL minus HISTORY_TOK at j = 2 — what a PERFECT draft
    token adds over everything free at the anchor for the forward it
    feeds; DRAFT_FREE minus FREE_TOK and DRAFT_FULL minus DRAFT_FREE
    reported beside it.
  STAGE LABEL: PREFETCH-HEADROOM if not CACHE-SUFFICIENT and HISTORY or
    INTRA-FORWARD reads SIGNAL; PREFETCH-NOT-SHOWN if not
    CACHE-SUFFICIENT and neither does; INCOMPLETE if any registered arm
    or any label cell is missing on the primary harvest. THE SIDEBAND
    SENTENCE follows ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN alone: SIGNAL — "the address
    stream adds a material margin over the free input token at this
    reader"; NOT-SHOWN — "no material margin of the address stream over
    the free input token is shown at this reader" (prefetch on this
    model is then a token-table matter at this reader: the K-2 shape);
    NEGATIVE — "the address stream reads below the free input token at
    this reader". HISTORY and PREFETCH-HEADROOM are scoped to
    address-only readers against the cache policy and license nothing
    about the address stream being needed once tokens[t] is in the
    reader. Every label is scoped to the registered linear readers on
    the sorted top-8 id stream and to hit rate at the registered
    budgets.
- HONEST PREDICTION (pinned before any registered readout ran and
  before the second smoke; informed by disclosure 1 and by the first
  smoke, which is why it is written as direction plus a rough
  magnitude): CACHE-SUFFICIENT does NOT fire (RECENCY_16 at j = 1 near
  0.5; RECENCY_32 near 0.8, below the would-fire bar); HISTORY reads
  SIGNAL with the HISTORY arm near 0.7-0.8 at B = 16, a reading near
  +0.2..+0.3; ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN reads SIGNAL with a modest margin,
  +0.05..+0.10 (the range's lower end raised from +0.03 to the SIGNAL
  floor on the critic's second pass, a consistency fix made after the
  second smoke was seen; it moves the range's centre toward that
  smoke's +0.18 and changes nothing about how +0.18 or +0.16 score
  against the unchanged +0.15 surprise line) —
  NOT-SHOWN, or at or above +0.15, would surprise (the token feeds the forward directly and
  routing is token-specialised, so the free arm should carry most of
  it; the context that S[t] encodes is what could be left);
  INTRA-FORWARD reads SIGNAL at lead 1 and weakens with lead; DRAFT
  reads SIGNAL with a large addition, +0.10..+0.30 — below +0.05 (a
  NOT-SHOWN) would surprise, since the draft token IS the input of the
  forward being predicted; (iv) rises with depth, GATES<=16 well above
  FREE_PREV at offset 1 and both near the floor at offset 2. What would
  surprise most: CACHE-SUFFICIENT firing, HISTORY NOT-SHOWN, or
  ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN NEGATIVE.

  tokens[t+2]: the registered key leads by +0.14, so the token arms are

  ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN, applied as the SCOPE sentence beside the
