- THE BALANCED LENS (pinned here, BEFORE tools/build_balanced_groups.py
  runs; the first successful build is the artifact,
  results/real/concept_groups_olmoe_balanced_v1.json, committed in the
  freeze and sha-cited by every payload): the SAME transition matrix as the
  registered lens (tools/build_concept_groups.transition_matrix over the
  glue-dropped k512 concept chains of the TRAIN-split rows of the primary
  harvest, all 8 seeds; S = P + P^T; the 490 nonzero-degree concepts; the
  harvest meta's buckets512 sha asserted), then FIEDLER-ORDER QUANTILE
  BINNING: the symmetric normalised Laplacian L = I - D^-1/2 S D^-1/2 on the
  nonzero subgraph (one connected component, asserted; a disconnected graph
  is a refusal, not a fallback), its eigenvector for the SECOND-smallest
  eigenvalue (numpy.linalg.eigh, deterministic), the Fiedler coordinate f =
  D^-1/2 v with the sign fixed so that the highest-degree concept's
  coordinate is non-negative (ties on degree to the lower concept id);
  concepts sorted by f ascending (ties by concept id); cut into 16
  CONTIGUOUS bins of sizes 31 x 10 then 30 x 6 (490 = 16 x 30 + 10; the
  larger bins first); the 20 zero-degree concepts assigned one by one, in
  concept-id order, to the currently smallest bin (ties to the lower bin
  id), so every group ends at 31 or 32 concepts (cap 32 against the lopsided
  lens's 268); glue stays class 16 (17 classes, as the registered L3). The
  artifact records the eigenvalues, the sign anchor, the bin edges, the
  group sizes, the zero-degree assignment and the same persistence
  diagnostics the registered builder records (train full-chain and
  glue-dropped persistence of the L3 chain under this lens, beside the
  lopsided lens's and k16's), as DESCRIPTIONS. WHY THIS PROCEDURE, decided
  before any number: it is deterministic (no k-means restarts), balanced by
  construction (no cap tuning), uses the same affinity the registered lens
  used (so "balanced" is the only change), and the Fiedler order is the
  standard spectral ordering of a graph (a 1-D embedding, which is a
  weaker use of the spectrum than 16-way spectral clustering; said as a
  limitation). ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED AND NOT USED: size-capped k-means on
  16 eigenvectors (a cap to tune, restarts to seed), recursive bisection to
  a cap (a cap to tune, variable group counts), a 17th class for the
  zero-degree concepts (changes the class count against F-25). NO SECOND
  LENS is built whatever the labels read (OQ-13 (ii)'s rule; a lens
  question answered differently by two lenses is reported as such, never
  re-lensed). Space name L3_olmoe_balanced_v1; offsets {2, 3, 4} as the
  registered S3 L3. The builder records its own sha and repo-relative paths
  in the artifact's provenance from the freeze on (c, A11; the committed
  artifact predates that patch, see PRE-FREEZE (c)).
- THE READERS (pinned; R-0, R-N and R-L train with the registered trainer
  sideband.probes.train_probe — AdamW, batch 4096, VAL-selected epoch, TEST
  read once — on the registered blocks assembled in the registered order,
  through a runner in the new tool that reproduces run_probes.run_cell
  bit-exactly for R-0 on the (a), (c) and factory-extra arms (a CI test; c,
  A10); R-T trains with a two-tower trainer in the new tool that reproduces
  train_probe's loop and is bit-exact with it when no slots tower exists):
  R-0  the REGISTERED reader (mlp256: Linear(d, 256) -> ReLU -> Linear(256,
       n_classes); 30 epochs, lr 3e-3), the LENS stage's reader and the
       identity against F-24 / F-25.
  R-N  HZ-RESCALED (c, B8; re-pinned from a four-family normalisation, which
       under AdamW would have changed four per-family effective learning
       rates at once and slowed the slots block about 11x): the hz block
       ALONE is multiplied by c_HZ = sqrt(m_SLOTS / m_HZ), where m_F is the
       mean over the cell's TRAIN anchors of ||x_F||^2, m_SLOTS taken from
       the ALIGNED slots block at the same anchors (so c_HZ is the same
       constant for the three arms of a cell, fplus included, and fplus_b
       and fplus_r stay equal-dims with identical scaling); A, TOK and the
       slots block (aligned or twin) are unscaled; then the registered
       mlp256 trainer at the registered budget. One float per cell,
       recorded with m_HZ and m_SLOTS. It is one change, the one F-24 named.
       ADAM EQUIVALENCE, said in words: under AdamW, scaling one input
       family by c equals scaling that family's first-layer initialisation
       and effective learning rate by c (Adam's normalisation cancels the
       gradient scale; decoupled weight decay is unchanged), so R-N is the
       registered reader with the hz first-layer weights initialised and
       stepped smaller relative to the rest by the measured c_HZ (about
       1/4 by the block structure, sqrt(128 / 2048): a 128-hot slots block
       against the 2048 standardised hz dims the 4753-dim S3 arm implies,
       before clipping; c2, A3 — the first draft's 1/6 used S1's 4096-dim
       hidden state; the payload records the measured value).
  R-T  TWO-TOWER: tower A = Linear(d_A, 256) -> ReLU over A ++ TOK ++ HZ;
       tower B = Linear(d_slots, 64) -> ReLU over the slots block (aligned or
       twin) where present; head = Linear(256 + 64, n_classes) over the
       concatenation; the registered budget (30 epochs, lr 3e-3). Parameter
       construction order: tower A, head, tower B — so for fplus (no slots
       block) the model IS mlp256 with the identical seeded initialisation,
       and the two-tower trainer must reproduce train_probe bit-exactly
       there (a CI test). It gives the sparse block its own first layer, so
       it is not forced to share one with the dense blocks (c, A2): the
       second mechanism F-24's epoch disclosure points at. LICENCE READOUTS
       UNDER R-T COMPARE ARCHITECTURES (c, A2): D = acc(fplus_b) -
       acc(fplus_r) is architecture-matched (both two-tower), but Mt and
       Mn_r compare a 320-unit two-tower model (fplus_b, fplus_r) against
       mlp256 (fplus), so under R-T the licence measures architecture plus
       content; said beside every R-T licence.
  R-L  LONGER BUDGET (conditional stage): the registered mlp256 model, 60
       epochs at lr 1e-3, VAL-selected epoch (train_probe's own kwargs; no
       other change).
  Every reader is a statement about THAT reader; the four together do not
  establish K-2's universal "never beat" either, and the block says so under
  every label. A reader that removes BOTH mechanisms at once (two-tower AND
  hz-rescaled) is NOT run (one change per reader, so a SURVIVES can be
  attributed); said as a limit.

  each with torch limited to six threads and CUDA hidden; the stages run in
  order and each writes its own payload; a later stage launches only after
  the earlier stage's payloads are read as pinned):
  STAGE LENS (reader R-0, space L3_olmoe_balanced_v1, offsets {2, 3, 4}),

- READOUTS (pinned; the frozen chain's, imported): per (reader, space,

  pairwise reading, the replication computed identically; the frozen
  source_label rule needs BOTH harvests):
  STAGE LENS. (i) PROXY-LENS, from the fresh linear P at off2 under the
  Phase-3 triple rule (CI95 lower > 0, all three seeds positive, point >=

  LENS-SURVIVES shows that the (c) - (a) margin EXISTS under a size-capped

- DISCLOSURES. (1) No cell of this registration has trained; no statistic
  across arms or across the two lenses was computed before this block was
  written; the smoke under PRE-FREEZE (b) re-trains ONE committed-type cell
  (S3 L3 at the LOPSIDED lens, off2, fplus, mlp256, seed 0, whose CUDA
  result F-25's state file already holds) on CPU to calibrate runtime and
  to record the CUDA-vs-CPU test_acc difference; it loaded the balanced
  label map (its sha is in the smoke payload) and trained nothing on it (c,
  A13); it read no reader-variant cell. (2) The balanced lens is built from
  TRAIN tokens only (the transition chains), before any probe trains, and
  its sizes and persistence are disclosed under PRE-FREEZE (c) as
  descriptions. (3) The readers are the assistant's constructions from
  F-24's two disclosures (norm dominance; early best epochs); R-N was
  re-pinned by the critic's round from a four-family normalisation to the
  hz-only rescale (c, B8); a reader that removes BOTH mechanisms at once is
  NOT run (one change per reader). (4) CPU training through torch with six
  threads: a rerun with the same thread count is expected to reproduce a
  cell bit-exactly. LANDING CONDITION per stage (c, A4): one gate cell per
  reader on the primary, seed 0, re-run from a clean clone to a scratch
  path with `python tools/run_reader_lens.py --smoke-cell
  <READER>|<space>|2|fplus_b|mlp256|0 --harvest <ABSOLUTE path to
  results/real/harvest_moe> --out <scratch>.json --threads 6` (the harvest
  npz files are gitignored, so a clean clone has none of its own), its
  state row IDENTICAL EXCEPT runtime_s (every row carries wall-clock); a
  non-identical rerun is said in words with the discrepancy and the stage
  still lands — CUDA runs were never rerun-exact and the record's
  determinism note says so. The R-0 linear (a) cells re-trained in the
  readers stages are the second rerun check (STAGES). (5) The two harvests
  are a primary and a SEED replication on the same prompts, as F-24 /
  F-25; "both harvests" is agreement across seeds, not across prompt sets.
  (6) STAGE READERS adds no rider cells on a null board: the rider tests
  feature alignment on shared blocks that are byte-identical to the
  rider-checked ones; on a POSITIVE result the reader-matched rider under
  LABELS is pinned before any REOPENED word is final (c, A1). (7) The
  frozen chain (run_fullfree_coarse_amended -> run_fullfree_coarse ->
  run_fullfree, run_fullfree_twin, run_oq18_rider_diag, run_posthoc_topic,
  run_probes) is imported, never edited; the new tool asserts the amended
  instrument's frozen sha at import and attests its own raw bytes; the
  closure grows by this one file. (8) Line endings: evidence written LF;
  the tool carries `-text` from the freeze. (9) The GPU is not used (the
  operator's job runs on it; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is emptied at import and
  recorded); the budget is CPU hours and is said as an estimate until
  measured. (10) Prior art: not re-searched for this registration — the
  readers are standard constructions (an input rescale; a two-tower head)
  and no novelty is claimed; the value is the measurement on this record's
  own cells. (11) RESUME AND RECOVERY (c, A5): a registered run that
  crashes resumes with --resume at the SAME HEAD (the state header records
  HEAD at launch; a different HEAD is refused); a tracked tree found dirty
  at payload time is recovered by restoring the tree and re-running with
  --resume over the complete state file, which retrains nothing; the
  payload's resumed_cells is the number of rows taken from the state file
  rather than trained in that process, and a payload with resumed_cells >
  0 says so at landing. A TORN FINAL LINE (a crash mid-write) is cut off
  the state file on --resume before any row is appended, the dropped byte
  count recorded in the payload (torn_bytes_dropped_on_resume), so the
  resumed file loads whole (c2, A4; without the cut the next row would
  follow the torn bytes and the stage could not be concluded); the cut
  runs AFTER the header and HEAD checks, so a refused resume cuts nothing
  (c3, A2). HEAD MOVED
  MID-RUN (c2, A5): the recovery is a detached checkout of the launch HEAD
  recorded in the state header, then --resume from a clean tree; a stage
  that cannot be returned to its launch HEAD is VOID. (12) GUARDS (c, A5): the git check runs at the repo
  root and fails CLOSED on a registered out (a failed git is a refusal, not
  a clean-looking "unknown"); --threads must be 6 and --n-boot 2000 (the rider
  and every CI; c2, A6); the tool must be git-tracked; a registered out
  refuses --only / --smoke-cell, a non-CPU device, a companion flag that
  disagrees with HARVEST_FILES, an existing state file without --resume.
  (13) INSTRUMENT AMENDMENTS (c2, A7): --conclude-from binds every payload
  to the CURRENT tool's bytes, so the tool is frozen from the first
  registered run; a dated amendment of a reader is a NEW file that imports
  this one (the OQ-18 precedent, run_fullfree_coarse_amended), never an
  edit, or the earlier stages could no longer be concluded. (14) The reflect
  pass counts the "[..]" placeholders of the pinned sentences in this block
  as placeholders; they
  are the slots the landing fills and are intended.

## Eval protocol (non-negotiable)

- Paired seeds across policies; telemetry on an isolated RNG stream (D-6).
- Analytic per-position acceptance as headline; empirical by-offset is
  survival-conditioned and reported separately (D-9).
- Free-information baseline in every table (D-5).
- Concept-space hygiene for predictions and gates (D-7).
- Findings land in FINDINGS.md with regime + evidence or they didn't happen
  (D-4; `make lint`).

## Defaults and tuning

β = 3 (gated) as the starting point; sweep {1..4}. τ = 0.5 scaled to decoder
quality (F-5). γ = 4 until OQ-3 measures real bucket persistence; F-4's rule:
hold a bucket only while expected run length ≫ γ. k (buckets) = 512 first;
the audit summary is cheap to recompute per k from one rejection log.

## Model menu

- Spec-decode pair: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
  (mirrors SD^2 for comparability).
- Routing telemetry: allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B (rich 64-expert stream, single-GPU);
  Mixtral-8x7B or Qwen-MoE later for scale.
- Gate module regexes are documented in real/moe_telemetry.py; verify with
  `--list-modules` before trusting them.

## GPU port checklist

1. `pip install -e ".[real]"`; `make test` still green (torch tests unskip).
2. `python -m sideband.real.bucketize_vocab --model <target> --k 512`.
3. `python -m sideband.real.hf_specdec --target ... --draft ... --buckets ...`
   on 20 prompts; sanity: acceptance ≈ published same-family numbers (~0.6–0.8).
4. Phase 0a audit at full prompt count; log the kill-shot number.
5. `moe_telemetry --list-modules` on OLMoE; verify the gate regex; harvest.
6. Only then touch probes/steering.
